name: Prologue
desc: Lucia meets with a prison counselor to talk about her arrest and her chances of early release.

p: GTA 6 opens with Lucia standing in her jail cell in Hamlet Correctional, looking out the window. Turn around, focus on a cellmate, and press the corresponding button to talk to them.

After a short while, a guard named CO Wilson unlocks the cell to take Lucia to the counsellor's office. He stops in the common area to answer the phone, then walks to the cell door in the right corner. Keep following him down the corridor until you reach the office. A cutscene starts, introducing you to Stefanie . The counsellor's questions trigger a flashback to the crime that put Lucia behind bars, where you take over.

In a flashback, Lucia leaves a coffee shop and decides to rob a Payday Loan store for some quick cash. You take control inside the shop: aim your gun at the teller, threaten him, and grab the money he puts on the counter. A customer will try to restrain Lucia, so complete the quick time event to shake him off.

Run from the store with the police on your tail. The flashing blue and red circle on the minimap shows the area the cops are searching. The police will be relentless in their pursuit and will try to subdue you with stun guns. You will either be apprehended or will try to run away, only to find the screen cuts to black and a cutscene plays.
Tip: You can't actually escape here. The chase is scripted, and after a while the game cuts back to the counsellor's office on its own, so don't waste time trying to find a way out.

When you take control of Lucia again, the chase is over, and she needs to head back to the coffee shop, marked with a dot on the minimap and on the compass. As you get close, the police arrest her: this is unavoidable.
Tip: If Lucia runs out of health at any point during the prologue, you get a different arrest scene: rather than being put in a police car, she is cuffed and taken away inside an ambulance.

The final cutscenes reveal why Lucia went back despite the danger: she had left her baby son, Tommy , at the coffee shop. Staff had already reported the child abandoned. Tommy is taken into child welfare, and Lucia ends up in custody. Her goal now is to get out of prison and be reunited with her son. The mission ends here, and the story moves straight on to Gone Fishing .

name: Gone Fishing
desc: A smuggling run with Cal and Donnie goes wrong, and Jason has to head into Kingfishers territory in Pelican Valley.

info.Rewards: $100–$220 (depends on how the mission goes) + 1 unlock

sections.h: Follow the Plane and Collect the Packages
p: The mission opens with Jason and his friend Cal out on a boat. Donnie , a pilot, drops drug packages from his plane into the sea. Drive after the plane and slow down next to each package so Cal can fish it out of the water.

sections.h: Watch the Deal in the Swamp
p: With the packages on board, follow the pink route on the minimap to the swamps. Equip the binoculars from the bottom right slot of the weapon wheel, zoom in and watch the meeting on the docks. Donnie is dealing with the Kingfishers gang, but things go wrong, and they take him prisoner, so it's up to you to get him out.
Tip: The binoculars can also be used to study animals. Studying 100 of the 255 species counts towards 100% completion, so scan every new animal you come across.

Drive to the nearby docks, where Jason gets off to search for Donnie alone. You can clear the camp in full stealth by sneaking up behind enemies and choking them out. Stay crouched and work your way to the far end of the camp, where Donnie is held in a shack. Click the left stick while crouched to move faster without being heard.
The shack is located in the far corner of the camp. There are patrols nearby, so be wary if you want to take the stealth approach. Of course, you can always opt for a guns-blazing approach.

You can locate it easier by following the big Turbine. The game even prompts you to do so by pressing and holding the right stick on the controller. It is a great way for the game to showcase how it presents points of interest and helps you navigate throughout the mission organically.

sections.h: Get into the Shack and Untie Donnie
p: Wait for the nearby guard to walk away before entering the shack through the front door. Untie Donnie inside. A brute then bursts in. Knock him out with your fists, blocking his attacks. Afterwards, pick up the Zombix healing item and equip a weapon.
Tip: Zombix is the healing item in GTA 6. You can carry up to five at a time and buy more at convenience stores.

Now you can fight your way out with guns. On the way to the plane, go into the nearby trailer and collect cash that Donnie says is inside. There will be a QTE encounter in the trailer, so stay on your feet.
Take out the enemy there and grab the money. This optional, missable task boosts your Professional reputation.
Whether you managed to get the optional objective or not, now it's time to run away in the plane!

Tip: GTA 6 has a reputation system. Shooting enemies in the limbs incapacitates them and builds Hardened reputation; stealth builds Professional reputation, and killing builds Psychopath reputation. Killing cops and civilians can make you Irredeemable, and at the two worst levels, the police may open fire on sight.
Keep shooting your way to the sea plane. Get in, take off, and fly to the pink marker at Brian 's Marina. Slow down, land on the water, and taxi to the marina.

A cutscene introduces Brian, Jason's boss. He runs a drug smuggling operation and also owns real estate. Jason works as his fixer, collecting rent from tenants and helping with the smuggling on the side.

After the cutscene with Brian, you will have to get in your car. This will be your first time driving a car in GTA 6! You have to drive your pal Cal home. You will get your first feel for the driving model and how it improved in the 6th instalment.
After dropping Cal off, you will get a cutscene, and then the last task of the mission is to reach your house.
After dropping Cal off, you have to drive to your own house and enter it.
Jason then returns to his house in the Keys, where Lucia calls to tell him she is getting out of prison early.

recompenses: Jason's house in Key Lento Unlocked
$100–$220 (depends on how the mission goes) Cash

name: Gear Up
desc: Jason visits the local Ammu-Nation to pick up a new longarm.

p: Jason needs a longarm, so head to the Ammu-Nation store close to his house. The car parked outside the house will get you there.
Walk into the gun store and talk to the clerk. You can choose between a shotgun and a tactical rifle, although at this point you'll probably only have enough money for the shotgun.

However, if you managed to scrape some more cash, you can always opt for a more precise solution to living problems, which is a tactical rifle. It is a little bit more costly but rewards you with a precise early-game weapon.

Be ready for a fight as soon as you leave the store: three members of the Kingfishers gang pull up in a truck and open fire. If you kill them, you get a phone call that ends the mission. If you die instead, you respawn at your house, and the mission ends anyway. Either outcome is fine and has no lasting consequences.

recompenses: Longarm weapon of your choice (shotgun or tactical rifle) Unlocked

name: Unwanted Attention
desc: Cal and Jason head to Hamlet to recover a payment owed to Brian from the police impound.

p: Talk to Cal on the beach in the north of Key Lento. Brian is owed a payment that is sitting in the trunk of an Imponte Phoenix, and the car has ended up in the police impound in Hamlet.

sections.h: Drive to the Impound in Hamlet
p: Hamlet is a small town to the northwest: follow the marker with Cal. On the way, Cal installs a police radio scanner app on your phone. It works passively from now on, so whenever you commit a crime or get chased, you'll hear the police radio chatter.

sections.h: Find the Phoenix in the Impound
p: Climb the fence into the impound lot, then climb over the containers in the back corner and drop down past the next fence. The area is guarded. Be careful: if you knock out the guards, the police notice they've stopped responding and send a patrol, so either stay fully stealthy or be ready to grab the car and leave quickly.
The car you need is the red sports car at the back of the lot, hooked to a tow truck. Get in the tow truck and unhook it, then jump into the Phoenix.
Tip: Use the WAiNK app on your phone to scan nearby vehicles. Scanning 200 of the 277 base vehicles counts towards 100% completion, so scan every new car you see.
Tip: There's another way into the impound: take the lift at the back of the lot. It brings you up to the roof, where you can scan the parked cars from above.

Drive up to the gate and wait for it to open. This part is scripted so the police always spot you, either through a guard or through the patrol checking on the guards. If a guard tries to drag you out of the car, mash the button to shake him off. Once the gate is open, drive away and escape the flashing search area on the minimap without wrecking the car. Turning a few corners or going off-road and then speeding down a straight road works well.
Once you've lost the police, the Pay 'n' Spray in Hamlet is marked. Drive in and respray the car,
You can change the car's color. It does not matter what color you choose. You will need to deliver the car either way. The color does not matter.
Park it in Brian's garage nearby. Make sure to pick up the $150 Brian left for you in the back room.
Tip: After a chase, the "heat" outline stays on the map, and the police remember your clothes and your car. Respraying the car or switching vehicles makes you much harder to recognize.

Open the item wheel and toggle your headwear and glasses: when their icons turn from red to white, that look isn't known to the police. Then go into the gun store next door and buy one of the outfits with the money from the garage. A new outfit makes you impossible to recognize.

After escaping the police, red icons in the top right corner show how recognizable your clothes, headwear and vehicle are. You can also keep spare outfits in the trunk of your car, buy clothes on the go, or simply duck behind the wheel while driving to stay hidden.

name: Lab Fees
desc: Jason collects Brian's rent from a gift shop that hides more than souvenirs.

p: Brian wants his rent from a gift shop that is really a front for an acid lab. When you reach the marker, the boutique is locked. Call Brian on your phone to access the shop, which properly starts the mission. Talk to the man behind the register, and he admits he doesn't have the money.
He will try to threaten you and pull out a bat. You can grab it by pressing Y or Triangle and threaten him instead, and he'll offer you some acid from the back room as payment instead.

sections.h: Enter the Lab and Collect the Acid
p: Use the keypad on the door in the corner of the shop. Unlock it with the code 0420 : the clerk tells you.
Alternatively, it is also written on a notepad in the same room. Pick up the acid, empty the cash register if you like, and leave the store.
Phone Brian again. He tells you to drop the acid off at his lockup further south.

sections.h: Stash the Acid in Brian's Lockup
p: Brian's Lockup is shown with a green icon on the map. The door code is 7700 . Go inside and put the acid in the stash to complete the mission.
Since you don't have a bank account yet, the $600 reward isn't paid straight away: it arrives later in the mailbox outside Jason's house, so remember to check it.

Tip: Fences like Brian buy stolen narcotics, jewellery, and marked bills. More fences unlock as the story progresses, and they all appear with green icons on the map. Stolen goods are carried in a bag, which you can store in the trunk of your car.

name: Pipework
desc: While collecting rent from Mandy, one of Brian's tenants, Jason ends up doing some home repairs.

p: Brian sends Jason to collect the rent from Mandy , one of his tenants. Talk to her outside her house. She refuses to pay until her blocked sink is fixed.
Mandy leads Jason inside, but instead of the kitchen, she takes him straight to the bedroom. You can let her keep talking or interrupt her to ask where the plunger is.
The plunger is on the floor of the bathroom, across the hall from the bedroom.
Go to the kitchen and interact with the sink. Use the plunger with the right stick, then use the wrench on the pipe.
Mandy then shows up in her underwear and tries to turn the rent collection into a booty call, convinced that she and Jason belong together.
However, the conversation goes, and the result is the same: she offers a cigar for the repair, Jason turns down her advances, and she angrily throws the cigar box out into the street.
Tip: Pick up the cigar box from the street on your way out to get the Macizo Cigar.

This isn’t part of the mission itself. Some time after Pipework, drive past Mandy’s house again and you can run into her in the middle of a shouting match with her neighbor. Step in and calm things down, and Mandy invites Jason inside for a chat: she makes it clear she has moved on from him and is doing better things with her life. She then heads off to take a bath. You can knock on the bathroom door, but Jason can’t go in.
Tip: There is no romance option with Mandy in GTA 6.

name: Just a Scratch
desc: Jason takes his battered Ganado to Joey at Coastal Auto Care for some much-needed repairs.

p: Jason's car needs some work. Take his personal vehicle, the '70 Ganado parked at his house, to the marker at Coastal Auto Care. If you've already wrecked the Ganado, make a manual save and load it from the pause menu: you'll respawn at home with the car parked outside.
Tip: This is also a favor for Lucia: the map note says she will appreciate having the car fixed up before she gets out.
Talk to Joey , who is standing outside the garage, then drive the car inside.

sections.h: Repair the Engine and Get a Respray
p: Select Full Engine to get the free repair, then go to Cosmetics > Respray and pick any color. This short mission introduces how Pay 'n' Spray shops work.

Ultimate Edition: while you're in the shop, open Pro Builds > Full Kits and pick Retro Build – Ultimate Edition , which is free for Ultimate Edition owners (the standard Retro Build costs money). It's optional and not needed to complete the mission, and since the Ganado is replaced later, it's a Chapter 1 bonus.

Tip: You'll be driving this same car for the rest of Chapter 1. You can come back to buy upgrades, but the Ganado will eventually be replaced, and any upgrades will be lost. Registering a new personal vehicle only unlocks during Chapter 2.

recompenses: Free engine repair and respray Unlocked
Retro Build kit for the Ganado (free with the Ultimate Edition) Unlocked

name: Get Shirley's Rum
desc: Jason's neighbor Shirley is thirsty for rum and asks him to pick some up from the store.

p: Shirley is Jason's neighbour in Key Lento. Once Pipework is unlocked, she calls out to you when you walk past. Talk to her and agree to buy her some rum to start this side mission.
Tip: Both of Shirley's missions can only be completed in Chapter 1 and disappear for good once you start Tourist Trap . They aren't needed for any trophy or for 100% completion.

sections.h: Ask the Clerk for Shirley's Rum
p: The Three Sheets Liquor store to the south is marked on the map. Go inside, focus on the clerk and ask him for Shirley's rum. You can also ask about the bird noises coming from the back.
This marks the Exotic Animals Front illegal operation behind the store, which you can come back to later.
Head back to Shirley and hand over the rum to complete the mission.

name: Steal the Scooter
desc: Shirley has an unusual plan involving her neighbor's mobility scooter.

p: Around a day after Get Shirley's Rum , you'll see Shirley arguing with her neighbor Peggy, who gets around on a mobility scooter. Shirley later calls out to Jason again: she's convinced that stealing Peggy's scooter might snap her out of her depression. Agree to help.

Peggy's house is behind Shirley's, on the other side of the water. Swim across or walk around by road. The scooter is parked in the driveway next to the stairs. Peggy comes out to shout at you, but her eyesight is so bad she doesn't recognize Jason. You can try to lie about why you're taking it or just ignore her and drive off.
Follow the road back around to Shirley's house. Peggy chases after you but falls over halfway. Shirley opens the door to her porch: drive the scooter inside to finish the mission.

name: Hey Arnold!
desc: Brian's long-time broker Arnold has stopped answering, and Jason and Cal help track him down.

p: After the run-in with the Kingfishers, Brian 's long-time broker, Arnold , has stopped answering his calls. Talk to Brian at the pool bar south of Key Lento.
Drive Brian's truck to the nearby liquor store and wait for Cal to get in.

A search area appears farther south in Maroon Key and becomes an exact marker as you get closer. Take the first road on the left, and you'll find Arnold outside a small building near the radar station. The meeting quickly turns sour, and Arnold's men open fire.

Arnold flees in a vehicle. Chase him while his henchmen shoot at you from motorcycles. You can pull out your gun and shoot while driving and use slow motion to make the gunplay a bit easier. Along the route, you'll hit a couple of stunt jump ramps on the bridge. When the car chase ends, Arnold continues on foot: run after him until you corner him at the docks.
Tip: Stunt jumps stay marked on the map even after you complete them. Filter the map for the Exploration icons (the magnifying glass) to see them all.
Arnold surrenders at the docks, and you have to choose what to do with him.
What do you do with Arnold?
Jason shoots Arnold on the docks.
Result: Hardened criminal rating
Arnold swims away and is never seen again. Jason tells Brian he won't cause any more trouble, and that's good enough for Brian.
Result: Restrained criminal rating

name: Island Dreams
desc: Kenton needs Jason to lead a bachelor party on a dive to a shipwreck, with some treasure hunting on the side.

p: Talk to Kenton in his Island Dreams shop by the beach. Kenton is a treasure hunter, and he's using a bachelor party dive trip to a shipwreck as cover for his search. Three guys from the party join you on the boat.

Drive the boat to the marked spot in the Atlantic Ocean. The guys will exchange comical banter along the way. When you arrive, interact with the yellow scuba gear at the back of the boat and jump into the water. The green bar in the top left shows your oxygen, and you have plenty of time.

sections.h: Escort the Bachelor Party through the Trench
p: Dive into the trench, which works like an underwater tunnel. The three bachelors follow you until you reach the shipwreck, the real reason you're out here.

sections.h: Search for Treasure Near the Wreck
p: Use the on-screen instructions to select the metal detector from the weapon wheel, aim it, and swim around the pink search area outside the wreck until its light turns from red to green. At the right spot, a golden chest icon appears on the seabed: interact with it and search for the three treasures.
Tip: While diving, you can study fish and other sea creatures just by swimming close to them. They count towards the 100 animals needed for 100% completion.

Once you have all three treasures, Dobbs gets stuck under a grate on the ship. Head back and lift the grate to free him. Once he's free, start leading the guys back to the boat. Equip the Arras Bullhead harpoon from the left side of the weapon wheel and brace yourself. A shark shows up and chases after Dobbs.
Do you save Dobbs from the shark?
Hit the shark twice with the harpoon, and it swims away.
Affects: Final cutscene only
Don't shoot, and the shark eats Dobbs.
Affects: Final cutscene only

sections.h: Escort the Bachelor Party to the Boat
p: Swim back to the boat with the survivors. Whatever happens, you'll never see this group again. Jason hands over the treasure he found and agrees to keep working with Kenton.

name: Feng Shui
desc: Jason and Cal hang out at home and rearrange the furniture before Lucia arrives.

p: Shortly after the Hey Arnold mission, you receive a text message from Cal , and a mission marker appears at Jason's house. The mission starts as soon as you walk in.
Grab a beer from the fridge and sit on the couch with Cal, who suggests rearranging the furniture before Lucia comes home.

Help Cal rearrange the living room furniture. After moving the coffee table, you can say it's fine or move it again. The result is the same: Cal will shift it back and forth until it ends up exactly where you put it in the first place.
Cal boots up his game console, and you get to try two minigames. The first is Tenebrae Lux, a black-and-white first-person exploration game. After it starts, follow the path towards the lighthouse.

While there, you will find a shed with two puzzles on the left. You can interact with it or keep moving. In this section, the goal is to spend some time in the game. No matter what you do, Jason will close the game after some time.
Next up is the top-down shooter Street Trash III. There's a timer, but you can't win this one either, so you can either die straight away or keep playing until it ends.
Jason and Cal hang out for the rest of what may be his last night as a single man. The next morning, Hamlet Correctional calls to tell Jason that Lucia is being released.

name: Pick Up Groceries
desc: Buy some groceries and bring them home before Lucia arrives.

p: Before Lucia comes home, stock up the house. Go into the marked grocery store in Key Lento and pick up the products highlighted with pink markers (they also show as pink dots on the minimap). Any three items will do. Each product is paid for the moment you take it off the shelf, so there's no need to go to the register.
Put the groceries in the trunk of your car, close it and drive back to Jason's house. Take the bags out and carry them inside: a short cutscene shows Jason putting everything away.

name: Buy Flowers
desc: Order some flowers for Lucia and have them delivered to the house.

p: Talk to the vendor at the marked flower stand in the south of Key Lento. You can buy a Large Bouquet for $10 or Roses for $25. Lucia will appreciate either, but the vendor comments on your choice, so go with the roses. The flowers are delivered to the house later, and there's nothing else to do.

name: Buy Lucia a Necklace
desc: Buy Lucia a necklace from The Siren's Chest jewelry store as a gift.

p: The jewellery store The Siren's Chest is in the south of Key Lento, right next to the barbershop from Get The Chop .
Talk to the clerk: Jason orders a custom gold chain engraved with the name of Tommy , Lucia's son. It costs $475. If you're short on money, rob a few store registers first.
Tip: This purchase is worth it. In Chapter 2, Lucia can offer the necklace as collateral, which gives you an easier outcome in a later mission.

name: Get The Chop
desc: Visit Barnacle Beauties to get a new haircut or tidy up your beard.

p: Go into the Barnacle Beauties salon, next to the jewellery store from Buy Lucia a Necklace . Talk to the stylist and pay for any new haircut. You can also change your hair color and trim or style your beard.
Tip: Unlike clothes, hairstyles don't stay unlocked. If you want to go back to an old look later, you'll have to pay for it again.

name: Get Lucia's Clothes
desc: Lucia asks Jason to collect some clothes from her friend Andy at the Manatee's Rest bar.

p: Some time after Feng Shui , an Unknown Caller rings Jason: it's Andy , a friend of Lucia's. Answer the call, and head over to the Manatee's Rest Bar in Key Lento to pick up some clothes for Lucia.
Ask the bartender, and he'll point you to the woman cleaning the tables. Lucia has told you she wears the same size as her.

sections.h: Follow Andy and Collect the Clothes
p: Walk with Andy to her car, and she hands you a bag of clothes. Put them in your car to complete the mission.
Tip: Keep the bag in the trunk and bring it with you when you pick Lucia up from prison in Coming Home . Drive carefully so you don't lose it.

name: Catch a Bigger Fish
desc: Cal bets Jason he can't land a stoplight parrotfish heavier than 2 lbs.

p: Once you have finished Feng Shui , Cal sends Jason a text daring him to beat his catch: a stoplight parrotfish of more than 2 lbs, caught at a marked spot in Gambit Bay, Mariana County.

You need a boat to reach the fishing spot. During Chapter 1, you can use the one moored at Jason's house; after that, it's no longer available, so take any boat you find. The docks next to the Rusty Anchor usually have a couple of fishing boats you can borrow.
Tip: The challenge stays active after Chapter 1, so you can come back for it later if you missed it.

Sail to the marked spot, open the vehicle menu and choose Anchor so the boat stays still. Select the fishing rod from the bottom-right slot of the weapon wheel; the standard Small Saltwater Lure is all you need. Cast, wait for a bite and reel the fish in.
Keep fishing until you land a stoplight parrotfish that weighs more than 2 lbs, then send it to Cal to prove you won and complete the mission.

name: Coming Home
desc: Lucia is getting out of Hamlet Correctional and needs a ride home.

info.Featuring: Andy Cal Hampton Donnie Katerina Rosselli Lori Heder Mattia Tauro

p: The morning after Feng Shui , Lucia calls to say she'll be released soon. The mission is marked at Hamlet Correctional, but you have to pass time until she calls again. Use this window for the five optional missions: Pick Up Groceries , Buy Flowers , Buy Lucia a Necklace , Get The Chop , and Get Lucia's Clothes . They all improve your relationship with Lucia, and the necklace is useful later in Chapter 2. It's also worth repairing Jason's house: fix the bedroom wall and paint it, the broken stairs, the roof (climb the ladder), and the railing on the workout balcony.

Tip: If you complete all the optional errands, the relationship starts at 3 out of 4 hearts (check the Jason & Lucia menu). Anything that affects it is shown by a heart icon on the right side of the screen.
When you're done, sleep at Jason's house until the next morning, and Lucia should call. Sleep again if she doesn't, or drive around until the call comes.

sections.h: Pick Up Lucia at the Prison
p: Drive to the prison in Hamlet, with Lucia's clothes from Andy in the trunk if you collected them. Talk to the guard at reception, and a flashback shows the day Jason and Lucia broke up. When Lucia comes out through the gate, lead her to your car.

Drive to the Rusty Anchor bar in the north of Key Lento and go inside. If you brought the clothes, Lucia heads to the bathroom to change while you meet Cal at the bar, and Donnie joins the party. Order two Pindayho beers from the bartender for $6, pick up the second bottle from the counter, and take both outside to Lucia. Find her behind the bar for a heart-to-heart cutscene.

After the cutscene, drink the shot on the counter and mingle. You can help Cal swipe through a dating app (he turns out to like older women) and Donnie offers to share some cocaine with you in the bathroom. Neither choice has any consequences. Then Kat , Lucia's former cellmate, arrives with her rich boyfriend Mattia , who is connected to powerful people.

sections.h: Dance with Lucia and Meet Mattia
p: Walk up to Lucia and follow the on-screen prompt to dance. The pregnant Kat lets Jason feel the baby kicking, then you go back to dancing until Andy shows up. Find Mattia on the phone behind the bar, offer him a drink, and fetch a beer from the bartender. Back at the bar, Mattia hints that he works for someone rich and challenges you to a game of pool.

Grab a pool cue from the wall and play a few shots. Before you can finish, a group of Aviators interrupts and Jason challenges them to a fight outside. Hold block when you see their shoulders start to turn, then hit back.

The police arrive to break up the fight, and Lucia can't be caught on the night of her release. After running away with her, you end up on a beach and then back home, where Jason and Lucia spend the night together. If you repaired the house, Lucia notices and appreciates it. The next morning, Donnie calls with a new job.
Tip: At the Rusty Anchor, you can pull Lucia away from Lori for a small relationship boost, and washing Jason’s hands at the sink gives a temporary Focus buff.

recompenses: Lucia is released and moves into Jason's house Unlocked

name: Clean Up After Donnie
desc: A lost package from Donnie's botched delivery is sending a signal near a fishing spot in Hamlet.

sections.h: Search the Area for the Package
p: The morning after Coming Home , Donnie calls Jason. One of the packages from his botched drop is sending a signal near a fishing spot in the swamps southwest of Hamlet. Head to the search area and ask the fisherman on the docks. He points you to the package on the shore, under a roof.
Inspect the package next to the fisherman. It's been opened, and he tells you a gang took the contents to a shack downriver.

sections.h: Search the Shack for the Cocaine
p: The shack is marked a little further south on your map. Take the boat parked next to the package and follow the marker to find three Kingfishers guarding it. Take them out, open the shack's door, and grab the cocaine.

sections.h: Deliver the Cocaine to Donnie's Trailer
p: Donnie's trailer is marked with a green fence icon over in Key Lento. Drive the boat there and drop the bag in the container. The $600 reward arrives later in the mailbox at Jason's house.

name: Buck Me
desc: Lucia needs a bank account for her community service pay, so Jason meets her at the Fleeca bank.

p: About half a day after Coming Home , Lucia calls Jason and tells him that she needs a bank account to receive her community service payments. Neither of them has one, so Jason agrees to meet her at the Fleeca branch in Key Lento.

Talk to the teller inside, who sends you to the manager at the table in the right corner. Follow him into his office. Your credit is so bad that you can't open an account, so he suggests a fintech app called BuckMe instead.
After a cutscene, you're back home with $100 deposited in your checking account as a welcome bonus. Open your phone and tap the purple "B" icon to launch BuckMe.
In BuckMe, open the Checking Account menu and use "Buck Yourself" to move the $100 into the Family Savings account.

Tip: Money in Family Savings can never be withdrawn, but it can never be lost either. Each savings goal unlocks discounts and raises your checking account limit. Purchases over $1,000 are paid through BuckMe, and you lose your pocket cash when you die, so it's best to deposit cash at ATMs regularly.
Tell Lucia about your savings?
Jason tells Lucia about the money he has put aside.
Jason keeps his savings to himself.
Tip: Your first Family Savings goal is $5,000.

name: Down to Earth
desc: Brian wants Jason at the marina for a new job, and Lucia decides to come along.

info.Rewards: $500 + $800 more if you sell the leftover cocaine to Donnie + 1 unlock

p: Once both Clean Up After Donnie and Buck Me are done, talk to Brian in his office at the marina and follow him outside to Cal and one of the boats.

The boat needs a pressure wash. Pick up the pressure washer from the ground and spray until all the green dirt is gone. Lucia turns up halfway through, curious to see what Jason's "job" actually involves.

Get into the seaplane with Lucia and fly to the marker in the far northwest of Mariana County. Land on the water near the boat waiting there. The smugglers throw a package into the sea. Lucia steers the plane while you fish it out with the pole.

The smugglers weren't paid as expected, and you didn't bring any money. The situation escalates into a gunfight. Take them out. Shooting them in the arms and legs keeps them alive and builds a professional reputation, while killing them builds a more violent reputation; either approach works.

Fly to the three marked spots and land on the water at each one; Lucia drops the packages for you. After the second drop, the coast guard gets suspicious, so Lucia throws the third package out while you're still in the air.

Lucia realizes she has 30 missed calls from her parole officer, who is on his way to Jason's house. Land at the dock and rush back. Hide the narcotics in the washing machine under the house while Lucia stalls the officer out front, then go and support her. She comes up with an excuse, and he leaves.
After the cutscene, Lucia shows Jason how to meditate on the terrace. This unlocks the first of the game's 18 Meditation Spots.

recompenses: $800 more if you sell the leftover cocaine to Donnie Cash

name: Meditate with Lucia
desc: Lucia invites Jason to take a moment and meditate with her at his house.

sections.h: Talk to Lucia in the Kitchen
p: This activity has no regular mission marker. It triggers the morning after Down to Earth . As Jason, talk to Lucia in the kitchen of Jason’s house: she mentions that she wants to meditate and heads out to the balcony with the training equipment.
Tip: Meditate with Lucia is missable: it’s only available in Chapter 1 and can’t be done later.
Follow Lucia outside. When you reach the balcony, an optional quest notification appears in the top-right corner of the screen, with a pink door icon on a black background.
Focus on Lucia and choose Accept: she shows Jason how to meditate, which completes the activity.

Tip: This meditation adds +1 to the counter of 18 meditations towards the Positive Mental Attitude trophy/achievement. It isn’t needed for 100% completion, which only requires 15 of the 18 meditations.

name: Find the Lost Drugs
desc: Follow the signals and search four areas of the swamp for lost drug packages.

p: This starts with a phone call after Down to Earth . Four search zones appear in the swamps, each hiding one to three drug packages. The packages beep and have a flashing yellow light. Collect them and sell them to a fence ( Brian or Donnie ), and try not to die or lose the bag along the way.

The southernmost zone has two packages: one is stuck in a tree on the beach where three enemies are waiting (take them out and shoot the package down), the other is in the water at the end of the dock in the south of the zone.

The second zone from the south has three packages: on the southern shore in front of the second burned house (coming from the east), inside the single burned house on the northern shore, and in the blue kids' pool with the slip-and-slide in the southwest corner.
The third zone has two packages, very close together where a group of alligators is resting. Shoot the alligators to scare them off and grab both packages.

In the northern zone, the packages have already been looted. You'll find an empty one outside the shed: go in, take out the two enemies and pick up the Half Brick of Cocaine they removed from it. Then drop all the bags off at Donnie's trailer.
Tip: Do this before Clear Skies to earn the most: the packages sell for $3,400 to Donnie or $2,720 to Brian.

recompenses: Packages can be sold to a fence for cash Unlocked

name: Deposit Cash Into BuckMe
desc: Deposit some cash into your BuckMe checking account at any ATM.

p: This task has no map marker: you'll find it in the mission list (open the map and select the storybook icon). Open the BuckMe app on your phone and choose "ATM Finder – Set Destination" to mark the nearest ATM. There's one right next to Jason's house.
Use the ATM and deposit some of your pocket cash into your BuckMe account to complete the task.

Tip: Pocket cash is lost when you die, while money in your account is much safer. If you carry no cash at all, purchases are paid directly through BuckMe, so there's little reason to keep money in your pocket.

name: Save for the Future
desc: Keep adding money to your Family Savings to reach the next goal and unlock new BuckMe perks.

p: Save for the Future has no map marker and runs through the entire story; you'll find it in the mission list. Use the BuckMe app on your phone to move money from your checking account into Family Savings. Each time you reach a goal, a new one unlocks after further story progress. It isn't required to advance the story.
Tip: Try to have at least $5,000 in Family Savings before starting Recalibration and Tourist Trap at the end of Chapter 1, because you lose all the pocket cash you bring into those missions.

recompenses: BuckMe upgrades at each Family Savings goal (higher checking limit and discount perks) Unlocked

name: Day Release
desc: Kat and Mattia invite Jason and Lucia out for a day of partying, starting at the Rusty Anchor.

sections.h: Meet Kat and Mattia at the Rusty Anchor
p: After Down to Earth , Kat and Mattia call to invite Jason and Lucia out. Go to the Rusty Anchor and order a drink from the bartender at the back to start the cutscene. Mattia's henchman Burim removes Lucia's ankle monitor, and you can choose whether to shake Mattia's hand (it makes no difference).

Get into the speedboat behind the bar and head for the yacht off the coast of Vice City. It's a long ride and the first time the story takes you this far north, so enjoy the conversation along the way.

After the yacht cutscene, you can choose to have Lucia ride with Jason, which improves their relationship, or go solo. Then race Mattia on jet skis, using the ramps along the route. Winning or losing doesn't matter.

Back on the yacht, you play as Lucia and shoot champagne bottles out of the air, using slow motion to help. Hitting all three gets a "three of three" comment from Jason but has no other effect. Lucia then checks on the pregnant Kat, who lets her pick one of her dresses to wear for the rest of the night.
Mattia is in the room in the middle of the lowest deck, two decks below where you start. Take the stairs down, walk around the yacht to the next set of stairs, and enter the room.
The party moves to Vice City at night, and you're behind the wheel of a sports car. Keep up with Mattia, where the objective then becomes a race to the Huxley Motel, the pink line on the minimap.

Walk into the Nine1Nine nightclub; you can hold hands, which sometimes improves the relationship. Talk to Mattia at his table, then dance with Jason as Lucia by pushing the left stick towards him and following the on-screen prompt.

The party moves on to a hotel apartment. As Lucia, go through the door on the right at the end of the hallway, where Mattia peeks out. The noise has alerted security, so the group escapes by jumping from the balcony into the pool; hold hands during this scene for another relationship boost. Afterwards, you're taken back to Key Lento as Jason.
Tip: Don’t miss Lucia’s free sunglasses: while looking for Mattia on the yacht, go to the middle deck and talk to the couple by the railing near the stairs going down. You can’t get them later.
Tip: The dress you pick is only cosmetic: Lucia wears it for the rest of the night, so there’s no wrong choice.

name: Clock Out
desc: Lucia finished work early and needs a ride home before 4pm.

p: At some point during the day after Day Release , Lucia calls Jason: she finished work early and wants a ride. Accept to start this optional mission. You must pick her up before 4pm or it fails; the time is shown on the minimap, your phone and the world map. The call doesn't always come, and it may require your relationship to be at Crazy in Love (3 of 4), so don't worry if you never get it.

Lucia is at the Key Lento Community Center, where she works. Make sure you arrive in a vehicle (any stolen car is fine): if you turn up on foot, she jokes about it and refuses to walk all the way home.
Drive Lucia back to Jason's house. She gets out on her own, and your relationship improves.

name: Clear Skies
desc: Brian has a job for Jason and Donnie that starts in Southwind.

p: After Down to Earth , Brian calls with a job for Jason and Donnie in Southwind. Go to the seaplane, and Donnie will send you to Brian, who is sitting at the tiki bar up the street.

sections.h: Take Off and Intercept Pilot Pete
p: Taxi the plane off the side of the road into the water and take off from there; taking off from the road is possible but riskier. Fly to the intercept point to the southeast, where another plane appears. Fly directly above Pilot Pete 's plane to hide its radar signature and escort it to the airstrip in the swamps.

Once Pete lands, fly to the next airstrip in the northwest of the swamps, land, and follow Donnie on foot to meet his Devil's Dozen contact. A group from the Final Chapter biker gang turns up, grabs Donnie and opens fire. Stay in cover, line up your aim, and pop out to shoot.
Tip: The bikers park several different motorcycles here, so it's a good spot to scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app.

Fight your way into the next building along the airstrip, clear out the bikers inside and untie Donnie from the chair. He leads you back outside where more enemies arrive. Take them out. If Donnie dies, you'll fail the mission and go back to the checkpoint.

sections.h: Hold Off the Final Chapter and Escape
p: While Donnie gets into the sea plane, a large group of bikers arrives. Hold them off so he can get away. Then grab a motorcycle and ride after him, ignoring the enemies who keep coming. Reach the meeting point east of Watson Bay and get into the plane. The cutscene leads straight into Building a Life .
Tip: After the shootout, check the bodies: if you don’t have a shotgun yet, you can take a Shrewsbury Hobo from one of them.

name: Building a Life
desc: Jason and Lucia work on their new home together, and Jason gives Lucia a lesson with a gun.

p: This starts as soon as Clear Skies ends back at Jason's house, where Lucia is failing to assemble a coffee table. When they finish talking, interact with the left side of the table and help put the screws in. Jason then realizes the pieces are installed in the wrong order, so you have to unscrew it again.
Take the glass top from the cardboard box behind Lucia and place it on the table, then watch the cutscene, in which Jason also teaches Lucia how to hold a gun.

recompenses: New coffee table for Jason’s house Unlocked

name: Ring the Bell!
desc: Cal talks Jason into a few drinks at the Rusty Anchor, and the night ends with Jason making sure his friend gets home in one piece.

p: After Day Release , as Jason drives to the marina to meet Brian at the start of Swamped , Cal texts him to say he is heading to the Rusty Anchor, the dive bar on the Key Lento seafront. You can turn him down, but he will message again. To play this mission, go to the Rusty Anchor before you meet Brian.
Tip: Ring the Bell! is missable: it's only available in Chapter 1, so stop by the Rusty Anchor before carrying on with Swamped .

Cal is out the back by the bar, chatting with Rhonda: she is the woman whose pet iguana, Princess, Jason can rescue in Coming Home . Cal offers Jason a shot, and it is entirely up to you. Accept it, and he soon pours two more: drink those as well, and Jason ends up tipsy, with a blurry screen and clumsier controls. Say no, and Cal takes it in good spirit, but he keeps drinking anyway.

Cal then goes inside the Rusty Anchor and calls Jason over. Follow him and talk to him: by now he is very drunk and asks Jason for a ride home. Pick Give Ride Home to carry on, or Give It a Minute to stall him; if you stall, you get one more chance to say yes, and turning him down again ends the mission with no reward. Even after agreeing, you can still walk away, but leaving Cal behind also means no reward.
Follow Cal outside, where he stops to relieve himself in the plants (there is an optional interaction here). Help him back up when he falls, then open the passenger door for him at your car.

Drive Cal back to his house. If Jason took the shots earlier, he is now driving drunk, and the car is harder to keep straight, so take it slow. Once you arrive, help Cal up the stairs to complete the mission.

Tip: A while later, Cal texts Jason to collect his prize from the Rusty Anchor wet T-shirt contest. This unlocks the White Rusty Anchor T-Shirt and the Rusty Anchor Cap at the bar: if you skip Ring the Bell!, they can never be bought.

recompenses: White Rusty Anchor T-Shirt (buyable at the Rusty Anchor) Unlocked
Rusty Anchor Cap (buyable at the Rusty Anchor) Unlocked

name: Swamped
desc: Brian asks Jason to meet him at the marina before heading out to see the Kingfishers.

p: Once Day Release , Clear Skies , and Building a Life are complete, go into the back room of Brian 's Marina to start the mission. Get into Brian's truck and drive him to the Kingfishers camp in the northwest of Mariana County. At the entrance, you talk to one of the gang members, then get out and follow Brian on foot.

Brian leads you to a pig pen. Wait for him to finish talking to Doug, then inspect the pen, where you discover the pigs are feeding on Donnie 's body. The Kingfishers have already killed him, and the meeting is an ambush meant to finish you off too.
Fight off the Kingfishers and follow Brian, shown as a green dot on the minimap. The gang has kidnapped Lori and is taking her away on a boat.

Get into the helicopter on the left side of the area and chase the boat. After the chase, shoot from the helicopter to take out the enemies on the ground and protect Lori. Whatever you do, one of the Kingfishers manages to put her in another boat, so the chase continues on the water.

Drive right up alongside Lori's boat and hold the button to jump across. Be quick and stay very close: if you're too far away, the jump won't trigger, and enemy fire will eventually destroy your engine and force a checkpoint restart. Once aboard, mash the button in the quick time event to take down the last enemy.
Tip: Back home, tell Lucia about Brian's retirement when given the option. It improves your relationship, while keeping quiet gives you nothing.

name: Don Gone
desc: Brian sends Jason to clear out Donnie's trailer in Key Lento.

p: Brian wants Donnie 's trailer to look as if he packed up and left town, so nothing links him to the operation. Go into the trailer and pick up the bag on the bed.

Find and pack the rest of Donnie's things; slow motion highlights them all. You need the photo on the wall above the bed next to the TV, the flight schedule on the nightstand under the Patriot Beer neon sign, the clothes on the shelf in front of the bed, Donnie's ID on the shelf to the right of the door, the message on the phone and the map on the fridge. You can also "do one for Donnie" with the drugs you find: it lowers your health and temporarily boosts stamina, and has no other effect.

sections.h: Leave Key Lento in Donnie's Car
p: As you leave the trailer, the three Aviators from the bar fight show up. Run to Donnie's car and drive off, or stay and beat them up. Then drive out of Key Lento, following the road north.
Tip: Before you destroy the car, open its trunk to collect Donnie's H&L .38, a unique weapon variant. If you skip it, it's gone for good.
It doesn't matter how you get rid of it. The easiest options are to pour the gas can from the trunk over the car and set it on fire, or to drive it into the ocean and let it sink.

name: Donnie's Lost Drugs
desc: Donnie's boat sank off Corsair Key with drugs still on board, and Brian wants them back.

info.Rewards: $1,200 (if you sell the drugs to Brian)

p: Brian mentioned that Donnie sank his boat off Corsair Key with drugs still on board. The search area is in the Atlantic off the northern coast of Key Lento: steal one of the boats near the shore, because swimming out there takes far too long.
Dive in the south-east part of the pink search area to find the sunken boat on the seabed. Open the compartment at the back of the boat and take the bag.
Take the bag to Brian's Lockup and sell it for $1,200.

recompenses: $1,200 (if you sell the drugs to Brian) Cash

name: Recalibration
desc: Cal is going through a hard time, so Jason and Lucia try to cheer him up.

p: During or after Don Gone and Donnie's Lost Drugs , Lucia calls, and the mission starts when you get home. Cal is grieving, and Lucia suggests cheering him up. Go to the marked liquor store and take any six-pack of beer from the fridge; it's paid for as soon as you pick it up.
Drive to Cal's house and find him on the lounger by the water behind it.

Take the boat to the marked fishing spot about two minutes away. Cast the lure, turn the right stick clockwise and press the button when a fish bites. Then push the left stick in the opposite direction to the one the fish is swimming in and spin the right stick quickly to reel it in.
Drive back to Cal's dock, follow him and use the grill to his right. Cook the three pieces of fish evenly, flipping them until both sides are done; Cal puts each one in a bun when it's ready.
Lucia says she isn't hungry and walks away. Follow her to the front of the house, where she blames her lack of appetite on heatstroke, and drive her home for another cutscene.

⚠️ Heads up: the next mission, Tourist Trap , is Chapter 1’s point of no return. Once it starts you are locked into a run of missions that carries on into Chapter 2 with no free roam, you won’t play as Jason for a long time, you lose all the pocket cash you carry and the Key Lento house is gone for good. Before you start it, finish anything you still want to do as Jason, put at least $5,000 into Family Savings and make a manual save in a separate slot.

name: Tourist Trap
desc: Mattia offers Jason and Lucia a simple job that could lead to well-paid work.

p: When you're ready to move on, talk to Lucia, who is picking up trash on the beach in the south of Key Lento. In the cutscene, Jason and Lucia accept a job from Mattia that could lead to well-paid work. He drops them off at the Visitor Center with what sounds like a simple task: collect a bag from a locker.

sections.h: Get the Bag from the Locker
p: Walk up the ramp and follow the long pathway to the lockers at the very end, then grab the bag.
On the way back, police appear and arrest you both. It was a trap: they were waiting for whoever came to pick up the bag, which turns out to be a key part of the story.
You're taken into the building for questioning. Captain Méndez arrives, desperate to get his hands on the bag. He's corrupt, and his men gun down the honest officers as chaos breaks out.
Jason slips his handcuffs and goes for the bag, but one of the corrupt cops shoots him and he's badly wounded. The game switches to Lucia: shoot the attacker.

As Lucia, shoot your way through the cops and follow Jason to the boat at the docks. Killing police here doesn't hurt your criminal profile, since it's part of the story. At the docks, drag Jason to the boat while holding off the cops with the pistol in your other hand.

Drive the boat out to sea following the pink waypoint, then all the way to Cal's house. Jason passes out from his wounds and Lucia hands him over to Cal, who takes him to Vice City Hospital for emergency surgery. Home Sweet Home starts straight away.
Tip: Lucia starts this mission with base health and Focus, so play carefully. On the way out of the interrogation room, grab the Moreland 850 shotgun from the fallen officer.

name: Home Sweet Home
desc: Lucia goes back to Jason's house to collect some of his things before the two of them skip town.

p: This starts immediately after Tourist Trap , with Lucia back at Jason's house to collect some of his belongings before they skip town. Go inside: two robbers have trashed the place and set it on fire. Fight them off. There's no time left to reach the cash, so run out of the front door before the house explodes.

A manhunt is now underway. Stay crouched and move through the dark towards the main road that runs through the middle of Key Lento. From there, steal a car and drive out of the search area or carry on on foot, keeping out of sight of the police. Near the edge of the search area, a cutscene starts the next mission: Discharge Time .

Tip: Before leaving, grab Tomás ’ photo from the small shelf to the left of the front door. If you call Andy and reach her car without being spotted, Lucia unlocks Andy’s Jacket, which you can miss otherwise.

name: Discharge Time
desc: Lucia heads to Vice City Hospital, but trouble is waiting for her there.

p: Lucia rushes to Vice City Hospital to see Jason. From the start, go left and up the stairs to the second floor. You can ask the receptionist for directions, or just follow the pink line on the floor through the door on the left. Jason is in room 203.

Lucia puts Jason in a wheelchair and tries to get him out, but the dirty cops and masked men who wrecked the house have sent reinforcements. While Lucia pushes the wheelchair, you control Jason and shoot the attackers.

Lucia leaves Jason for a moment to find an escape vehicle, and an enemy walks in with a shotgun. Grab it from him and use it on the reinforcements; each shot pushes the wheelchair backwards. An enemy then shoots the nearby gas canisters, and Jason is knocked to the floor. Crawl forward to the gun, and Lucia arrives to flatten the enemy with an ambulance.

Play as Jason in the back of the ambulance and shoot the pursuing police cars. After a few minutes, a cutscene shows Jason and Lucia fleeing west to Kelly County and waking up the next day in a motel. This completes Chapter 1, and the story continues straight into Chapter 2 with What's in the Bag? .

name: What's in the Bag?
desc: Jason and Lucia wake up in a Port Gellhorn motel and finally take a look inside the bag.

p: Chapter 2 begins straight after Discharge Time . Lucia has checked herself and the wounded Jason into a motel room in Port Gellhorn, where they can lie low while he recovers. On the news, Captain Méndez , the dirty cop from the Visitor Center, is blaming them for the attack.

Playing as Lucia, examine what was in the bag from the locker. First up is a small statue of a woman: flip it over and read the note underneath, which says, "From my collection. She reminded me of someone." Then look at the hard drive, which the couple can't check because they don't have a computer.
In addition, you can inspect both items after the cutscene if you go to the bathroom and interact with the hidden stash under the bathtub.
Tip: Chapter 2 is mostly played as Lucia while Jason recovers. The Paradise Lost trophy / achievement for completing Chapter 1 unlocks during this short mission.

recompenses: Lucia becomes playable in free roam Unlocked

name: Ambulance Chaser
desc: The ambulance from the hospital escape is still nearby, and Lucia needs to get rid of it before the cops find it.

p: The mission is marked as soon as you first leave the motel room after What's in the Bag? . The ambulance is hidden in a barn just east of the Starlet Motel: take the stairs at the back to get in. A group of addicts has found it and they drive off in it.
Jump on the ATV quad bike in the barn and chase the ambulance, staying close and avoiding crashes. It eventually stops by itself after hitting a tree further south.

Pick up the red gas can on the ground behind the ambulance, pour the fuel over it and use the Ignite prompt to set it on fire (or throw the can into the back and shoot it). The explosion alerts the police, so leave the area straight away.

Tip: This mission is missable: if you don’t do it before Slam Dunk , the police find the ambulance and the objective disappears. Failing to stop the junkies or destroy the ambulance also hurts Jason and Lucia’s relationship and can raise the motel rent.
Tip: The quickest way to destroy the ambulance is to step back and shoot one of the oxygen tanks in the back. To stop it first, use Combat Focus: the tires light up yellow.

name: Play Nurse
desc: Keep checking in on Jason at the motel until he's back on his feet.

p: This mission has no map marker of its own: you'll find it in the main mission list under Map > Story. It runs throughout Chapter 2 and can't be completed straight away. Go back to Jason's room at the Starlet Motel at the end of each day to see if he needs anything. From time to time a cutscene plays where Lucia looks after him, which improves your relationship.

Tip: You can't miss this one. Returning to the motel is required at several points in the chapter (the motel icon turns pink when it's needed), and the mission completes automatically after Breakfast Run .
Tip: Between check-ins, use the weights and kettlebells by the motel pool to train Lucia’s strength and raise her health bar.

name: Overnight Charges
desc: Go to the motel's front desk and find out how much is owed for the room.

p: Leave the motel room and head into the reception on your left. Linda , the manager, isn't very welcoming and insists the room is paid for right now.

If Jason bought Lucia the necklace in the optional mission Buy Lucia a Necklace , Lucia automatically hands it over as collateral. That's enough for Linda for now, and the mission ends immediately; you'll get the necklace back once you pay with cash later on.
Tip: Inspect the map on the reception wall to uncover the whole Port Gellhorn area on your map.

Tip: Linda wants the rent plus 10%, $900 in total. You start Chapter 2 with only $146, so she keeps Lucia’s necklace until you pay. Before leaving, inspect the flyer that marks the optional mission, Check Out McKittrick Farm, and look at the missing posters on the wall to add Gellhorn’s Missing Tourists to your map.

name: Just Moved In
desc: Pick up some supplies from the Alpha convenience store near the motel.

p: Go to the gas station across the street from the Starlet Motel and enter the Alpha convenience store. Eight items are marked on the minimap: soda, protein bars, fruit, soup, gauze, bandanas, hair clippers and a makeup bag. Each item is paid for as soon as you take it from the shelf, so there's no need to talk to the clerk.
Once you have everything, take the supplies back to your room at the motel.
Tip: The shopping comes to $55, and taking care of Jason this way improves his relationship with Lucia.

name: Girls' Trip
desc: Jason needs painkillers to recover from his surgery, so Lucia asks around the motel.

p: After Overnight Charges and Just Moved In , a search area appears at the Starlet Motel. Talk to Zach, who is peeking through windows between your room and the reception: he tells you to see Vicki in Room 10. Knock on her door and pay her $50 for some pills.

Take the pills back to Jason, who points out they're just ordinary over-the-counter Zombix. Go back to Room 10 to confront Vicki. Lucia talks her down, and Vicki agrees to help find real painkillers from someone she knows.

Drive Vicki's car into Port Gellhorn, west of the motel, and stop at the Delights strip club where she works. Follow her inside to meet her boss, Frankie Delight , who hands over her paycheck, then return to the car.
Vicki's dealer, Dunk , should have painkillers, but he isn't at his trailer. Try the boatyard next, where his friends say he went to sell at the car wash.

sections.h: Deal with the Kolts at the Car Wash
p: At the car wash, Dunk is in trouble with the Kolts gang and escapes through the shutter door, leaving you to face them. Choose "Defuse" twice to calm things down without a fight and earn Professional reputation, or provoke them and fight. Then lift the shutter and chase Dunk's car until he crashes at a farm.
While Vicki deals with the rangers, drive Dunk back to his trailer. He's out of painkillers, but says he can get more from his supplier, " Doctor Bill with the Pill".
Tip: Once this mission is done, Chapter 2 opens up: steal a car and take it to Moses first, as having your own ride makes getting around Port Gellhorn much easier.

recompenses: $50 back from Vicki via BuckMe Cash

name: Pick Up a Gun
desc: Head to Gellhorn Outfitters to buy a gun or grab one of your weapons from the locker.

p: This short optional mission is marked after Girls' Trip . Go into the Ammu-Nation in Port Gellhorn and either buy a weapon or use the green weapon locker to take back one of the guns you already own.
If you do have the Ultimate Edition, you can also change the variant of some weapons you own to a yellow/gold unique one!
Tip: Optional missions show as black icons with pink letters on the map. You need to complete 100 optional missions for the 100% Completion checklist, so do them whenever they appear.
Tip: The cheapest new gun at Gellhorn Outfitters is the Scorpio Nipper .38 for $495, but recovering your old weapons from the Weapons Locker costs nothing.

recompenses: A weapon of your choice Unlocked

name: Moses
desc: Vicki said a mechanic named Moses could set Lucia up with a ride, so take a low-key car to his shop.

p: After Girls' Trip , drive any car into Moses 's garage in Port Gellhorn to meet him. If the car you bring has no tracker, you'll be able to register it at the end of the mission; if it has one, Moses sends you out to find an untracked vehicle later.

Follow Moses to the yard behind the garage, where three vehicles are parked. Hold the button to pull up the WAiNK app and scan them: the bottom right corner shows whether a car has no tracker, a standard tracker or an advanced tracker.

Tip: Cheap cars usually have no tracker, mid-range cars have standard trackers that alert the police where you stole them, and supercars have advanced trackers that call the cops if you drive too slowly. Advanced trackers need the Key Cloner, which you get in Chapter 3.

Grab the Slim Jim next to Moses: it lets you break into locked cars without setting off the alarm. Try it on the Montagne XL by interacting with the door and tilting the right stick until the bar turns from white to pink.

Walk back to the garage with Moses, who now offers to register stolen cars. If you didn't bring an untracked car, steal one on the main road through the middle of Port Gellhorn (he won't accept cars taken too close to his shop). Respray it a new color, then select Register: this becomes Lucia's personal vehicle.
Tip: From now on, you can sell untracked stolen cars to Moses, the quickest way to make money at this point. The garage closes for a minute or two after each sale.

Tip: Stealing cars and selling them to Moses is the best way to make money in Chapter 2. Pick cars parked alone at the back of parking lots, away from busy roads: if someone sees you take a car from the street, they call the cops.

recompenses: A registered personal vehicle for Lucia Unlocked
Selling and registering stolen cars at Moses Unlocked

name: New Look
desc: Visit the Pearl House Hair Salon to give Lucia a new hairstyle.

p: This one takes about a minute. Go to the Pearl House Hair Salon in Port Gellhorn, talk to the stylist and buy any hairstyle to complete the mission. If you're short on cash, mug someone or rob a store's register first.

In addition, in this part of the game you have access to Pawn Shops where you can sell some of your collectables if you have any. If you stumbled upon some, you might be able to sell some cards for a couple hundred $, which will get you closer to 150$ needed for your New Look.
Tip: Bring around $150. Lucia can also do the Wavy Topknot herself in any mirror at home, as long as her hair is long enough.

name: How Do I Look?
desc: Buy Lucia some new clothes, or pick them up cheap at Bargain World.

p: Head to the Bargain World clothing store in the south of Port Gellhorn and buy a new top and a pair of pants or shorts. Anything will do, and there's plenty to choose from.
The clothes here are quite cheap, so you do not need a lot of cash with you to get some new outfits, tops or shorts. It only takes like two pieces of clothing to complete the mission.
Tip: The cheapest way to finish is the Bargain World Ensemble on the mannequin, for $46.

name: Got Pills?
desc: Dunk will call when he has a lead on some painkillers for Jason.

p: This is a waiting mission with no map marker: it appears in the mission list after Girls' Trip and completes on its own. Dunk calls after a few in-game days, and the best way to speed things up is to work on the other available missions, such as Pick Up a Gun , Moses , New Look , How Do I Look? and Ambulance Chaser .

After the first call, the mission changes to "Dunk Will Be in Touch", and you need to wait for a second call. When it comes, Slam Dunk unlocks. Alternatively, you can try to call Dunk like in the picture above. He might just give you the mission Slam Dunk right away. It is possible to call him first, before he calls you back.

Tip: Three cats live around the Starlet Motel: praise them until they come closer, then pet and feed them for a Focus boost, Professional criminal profile points and a little progress toward the next Focus level.

name: Daily Driver
desc: Moses wants an '82 Canis Crawler taken back from some clients who didn't pay.

info.Rewards: Up to $1,375 (less if the Crawler is damaged) + 2 unlocks

p: Shortly after Moses , he texts you a picture of the car he wants: an '82 Canis Crawler parked by the old Traders' Union building. It's the white jeep in the middle of the search area. There are a few enemies around: take them out or just run to the car and drive off.
If you are not quite sure what the car looks like, you can also check your phone for the attached photo!

Drive the Crawler to Moses's garage in Port Gellhorn, not far away. You get $1,250, plus $500 more if the car is in good shape. All that is left for you to do is just drive the car into Moses's garage, and the cutscene will play out, thus ending the mission.
Tip: Soon after, Moses gifts you the Port Gellhorn Garage to store vehicles, and you unlock the Vice City Real Estate app, which lets you buy more garages.
This mission unlocks garages in GTA 6. See how to unlock garages in GTA 6 for every garage location and price.

recompenses: Up to $1,375 (less if the Crawler is damaged) Cash
Vice City Real Estate app Unlocked

name: Behind on Payments
desc: Linda is holding the necklace as collateral until the $900 owed for the motel room is paid.

p: After Overnight Charges , you owe Linda $900 for the motel room. You'll earn enough by doing the other Chapter 2 missions first. After Moses , you can also sell stolen cars for quick cash, or mug people and rob store registers if you want to pay straight away.

Once you have the money, talk to Linda at the Starlet Motel reception to pay for the room. If she was holding Lucia's necklace as collateral, you get it back. In addition, Linda might increase your rent if you do not pay fast enough. In our case, the rent was 1500$, so don't wait up or you will have to cough up much more than 900$.
Tip: The rent is $900 if you talked to Linda right away, or $1,080 if you went grocery shopping first and she came to the room. Paying it gets Lucia’s necklace back.

name: Slam Dunk
desc: Go to Dunk's trailer and find out how he plans to get stronger painkillers for Jason.

info.Rewards: $1,700 from Dunk via BuckMe (next day) + 2 unlocks

p: After the other Chapter 2 missions and Dunk 's two calls in Painkiller Supplier, the mission is marked at Dunk's trailer in Port Gellhorn. Follow Dunk to a spot behind a dumpster and wait for Doctor Bill to show up at the convenience store.

Time skips to the afternoon and Bill arrives. Inside the store, he pretends not to know Dunk. Follow him to his car, where Dunk pulls a gun and forces him in. Bill explains he's retired and no longer has access to prescriptions, but he used to deal with the Kolts gang.

Drive to the docks where the Kolts are waiting. They let you through the gate: drive slowly behind the man walking ahead of the car. The gang gets suspicious about the surprise visit and opens fire, so reverse quickly, escape the compound, and lose the Kolts.
Bill calls Declan, his contact in the Kolts, then jumps out of the car and knocks himself out while trying to run. Go and pick him up; he's put in the trunk automatically.

Drive to the meeting point at the airstrip south-west of Port Gellhorn. The Kolts shoot Bill as soon as you arrive and turn their guns on you. Take them all out, including the ones inside the buildings; stay in cover and heal with Zombix if needed. Then go into the main building in the middle of the area, where Dunk grabs the pills.
Tip: Loot Bill's body before you leave for around $1,000 extra.

sections.h: Take Dunk Back to His Trailer
p: Drive Dunk home. Lucia then takes the painkillers back to Jason at the motel. Dunk now works as a fence, and when he calls the next day he sends you $1,700 and marks two robbery locations on the map.

Tip: When you pick a car to escape, keep in mind what each is worth and what it costs to register: Imponte ’82 Runner ($780 / $6,400), Declasse ’98 Burrito ($925 / $8,000, better to sell it) and Bravado ’95 Bison 900 ($900 / $7,400). The cops arrive soon, so don’t take too long.

recompenses: $1,700 from Dunk via BuckMe (next day) Cash
Dunk unlocked as a fence Unlocked

name: Breakfast Run
desc: Head back to the motel to check how Jason's doing.

p: After Slam Dunk , wait for Jason's call (around half a day; finishing any other pending main missions helps). The motel icon turns pink: go back to the room. A cutscene shows time passing until Jason is fully healed, and the couple decides to go on a robbery spree. First, drive to Hank's Waffles.

Pull out your gun, aim at the staff and threaten them. They open the register and put the cash on the counter: grab it. A one-minute timer appears in the bottom right, which is plenty of time. Leave, and you automatically arrive at the next store.

sections.h: Rob the Liquor Store and the Thrift Store
p: Repeat the same at the liquor store and the thrift store: threaten the clerk, take the cash, get back in the car. Jason and Lucia then hit a couple more places, a gas station and another liquor store.

Back at the car, you have a two-star wanted level. Small off-road trails are the easiest way to escape. A cutscene takes you back to the Starlet Motel, where Jason and Lucia spend the night together. The next morning, Vicki comes by for her laptop, and the story moves straight into Coffee Break .
Tip: This mission unlocks the Trust trophy / achievement and makes Jason playable again.

recompenses: Jason and Lucia both get a personal vehicle Unlocked
Cash from the robberies (the amount depends on how they go) Unlocked

name: Coffee Break
desc: After their string of stick-ups, Jason and Lucia sit down over coffee to plan their next move.

info.Rewards: BuckMe Silver Checking Account ($100,000 limit) + $2,000 interest if you reached the first $5,000 Family Savings goal + 2 unlocks

sections.h: Go to the Motel Kitchen with Lucia
p: This starts right after Breakfast Run , with Jason and Lucia outside the Starlet Motel. The kitchen is straight ahead, in the southern corner of the motel. On the way, you bump into Wyman , who suggests checking out the Mud Club for some dirt racing. Wyman is the man you could have helped repair his car in a random encounter in front of the motel earlier.

Lucia sits at a table. Use the coffee machine to buy a coffee for $2. In the cutscene that follows, the couple decides to keep working together and pull off something bigger so they can move to Vice City and stay with Jason's high school friend, Dre'Quan . It doesn't matter which plan you pick: all the follow-up jobs are marked on the map at once. It's up to you what to do next and in what order.
Go back to your car and hold D-Pad Right to open the partner menu. From now on, you can freely switch between Jason and Lucia, and give orders to your partner when they're with you.
The four jobs that open up can be done in any order: Thrillbillies , Hit Avery Pawn , Hit Kingpin Bowling and Impounded Vehicle .

Tip: Your BuckMe account is upgraded to Silver: you can now hold up to $100,000, the Family Savings goal rises to $100,000 too, and RydeMe rides cost 20% less. If you saved the first $5,000 in Chapter 1, you also get $2,000 in interest.

recompenses: Free switching between Jason and Lucia Unlocked
BuckMe Silver Checking Account ($100,000 limit) Cash
$2,000 interest if you reached the first $5,000 Family Savings goal Cash

name: Thrillbillies
desc: There's prize money to be won at the Thrillbilly Mud Club for anyone willing to get dirty.

info.Rewards: Up to $2,500 depending on your race position + Up to $2,500, depending on your race placement

sections.h: Buy a New Outfit at the Merch Stall
p: During Coffee Break , Wyman tells you about the dirt races at the Thrillbilly Mud Club, and the mission is marked afterwards. At the club entrance, go into the souvenir shop and buy clothes for both Jason and Lucia. When you step back out, a cutscene introduces Billy and his crew of dirt bike racers: Ricky, Brittney and Wyman.

sections.h: Rent a Bike at Roostere's Rentals
p: Billy wants you to race with his crew. Rent a Manchez or a Sanchez: the Sanchez costs more but is faster, and you'll earn the money back with a better finish.

sections.h: Beat a Member of Billy's Crew
p: Ride to the start line and race against 13 other riders. You don't have to win, just avoid finishing last to impress Billy. First place pays $2,500, and lower positions pay less (around $625 for third). Avoid hitting cars so you don't get thrown off the bike. After the race, Billy says he'll be in touch with more work. Later on, he will invite you on a mission: Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab .

recompenses: Up to $2,500 depending on your race position Cash
Up to $2,500, depending on your race placement Cash

name: Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab
desc: Billy is planning a job and needs one more rider to join his crew.

p: A few in-game hours after Thrillbillies , Billy texts you and the mission is marked in Port Gellhorn. Interact with the bench at the marker and Billy arrives with a Highwayman Sanchez dirt bike for you. He wants your help robbing an armored truck.

Follow Billy on the bike until a cutscene shows the armored truck. With the rest of the crew, chase it until it crashes into a tree on its own. There's no need to shoot: just focus on riding and stay on the bike.
Walk to the back of the crashed truck, plant an explosive charge and detonate it. The security guard climbs out and walks away: knock him out or leave him alone. Grab the bag from behind the truck.
Get back on the bike and stay close to Billy as he leads you up a mountain to regroup with the crew.
Tip: The Highwayman Sanchez is excellent for off-road stunt jumps. Park it in a garage after the mission and register it at Moses 's shop to keep it.

name: Hit Avery Pawn
desc: Lucia suggests hitting Avery Pawn in Port Gellhorn together, a shop full of valuables.

p: This is one of the four jobs marked after Coffee Break . Go to the pawn shop in Port Gellhorn, pull out your gun and threaten the staff, then smash the display cases to grab the jewellery. If you threaten them, they may also give you the code for the safe in the back (it may be randomized). In our case, the code was: 6943 .
As soon as you break a case or a door, the cops are called, and you get a two-star wanted level. Move fast if you want to leave before they arrive, at the cost of taking less loot.
Escape the police search area. A fast motorbike works well for weaving through traffic, and so does going off-road.

Take the bag to Dunk 's trailer in Port Gellhorn to sell the loot. It isn't required to complete the mission, but it's how you turn the jewellery into cash, and what you were able to take out from the safe.

recompenses: Cash from the stolen goods Unlocked

name: Hit Kingpin Bowling
desc: The bowling alley has been taken over by Kolt & Associates and looks like a good next target.

p: This is one of the four jobs marked after Coffee Break . The compound is full of Kolts gang members, so call your partner to come along (hold D-Pad Right and ask to meet up). Bring five Zombix from a convenience store, refill your body armor at Ammu-Nation, and buy sticky bombs there too: you need them for the safe.
Shoot your way into the bowling alley. For the Let's Go Bowling trophy / achievement you must loot all three key valuables:
Leave the bowling alley, grab a vehicle and escape the two-star wanted level. The trophy unlocks shortly after you get away.
Tip: The trophy isn't missable. If you miss a valuable, the bowling alley respawns some weeks later in in-game time (during Chapter 3): grab whatever you missed and the trophy still unlocks.

recompenses: Cash from the safe and stolen goods Unlocked

name: Impounded Vehicle
desc: Lucia's car has been impounded and she needs to get it back.

sections.h: Steal Lucia's Car from the Impound
p: Lucia's personal vehicle is impounded automatically after Breakfast Run . It shows as a green car icon on the map in Port Gellhorn, near the police station. Drive through the fence: the two officers there spot you and give you a two-star wanted level. Jump in Lucia's car and escape.

Tip: This works as a tutorial for impounded vehicles. If you leave your personal vehicle in a police search area after a crime, it gets impounded. Later, you can get it back instantly through the Scooter Bros app for a fee, or for free with daily credits if you buy the $12,500 premium tier.

name: Prepare for Vice City
desc: Make at least $15,000 while Dre'Quan sorts out a place to stay in Vice City.

p: This is an ongoing objective near the end of Chapter 2. Reaching $15,000 is required to unlock the final mission of the chapter, Checking Out . You can make the money however you like, but the easiest way is to complete the other jobs that are marked on the map: Thrillbillies and Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab for Billy , Hit Avery Pawn , Hit Kingpin Bowling , Impounded Vehicle , Veteran Hunted and Afternoon Delight .
Tip: Deposit your cash into BuckMe as you go, so you don't lose it if you die. A while after you reach $15,000 and clear the other main missions, your motel room is marked as the next objective.

name: Afternoon Delight
desc: Vicki wants to rob her boss at Delights and split the cash.

info.Rewards: $10,000 from Vicki via BuckMe (next day) + At least $1,800 in cash (from helping Frankie and Mario or from Frankie’s office)

p: Some time after Coffee Break , Vicki calls both of them about robbing her boss's strip club. If you go to the start alone, your partner is called in automatically. It's ladies' night, so the bouncer only lets Lucia in; as Jason, wait for the two bouncers at the back to walk away, climb the fence and go through the open door. You end up in the male dancers' dressing room, where lead dancer Mario wants Jason to join the show.
Does Jason join the dance routine?
Jason dances on stage with Mario and Lucky while Lucia slips into the back office, but she's caught by security, and Jason has to save her.
Affects: Mission only
The dancers quit, and Frankie takes the stage instead. Jason fires into the ceiling, and the robbery starts straight away.
Affects: Mission only
Either way, you end up robbing the safe in the back office. The code is 2008 . Opening it alerts the whole security team.

Shoot your way out of the club and drive away from the bikers chasing you; it's an easy escape. If Jason danced, you then spawn at a clothing store to buy him something to wear and drive to Vicki yourself. If he didn't, you go straight to the docks to hand her the bag. Vicki sends you $10,000 via BuckMe the next day.
