If you decided to help with the show, you will get an additional objective to get new clothes for Jason. You can actually get a pretty cool drip if you go through the hangers thoroughly enough.
If you helped and did buy new clothes for Jason, then after that you go regroup with Vicki instead.

recompenses: $10,000 from Vicki via BuckMe (next day) Cash
At least $1,800 in cash (from helping Frankie and Mario or from Frankie’s office) Cash

name: Checking Out
desc: When they're ready, Jason and Lucia pack up and leave the motel to meet Dre'Quan in Vice City.

p: Once you have $15,000 and have finished all available main missions, your partner calls about an article Cal sent. The motel is marked: go back to the room and interact with the bathroom door.
Grab the shotgun from the bed. The corrupt cops have found you: fight them off and head to the motel cafeteria, where Lucia is.

The game switches to Lucia: keep shooting. Jason heads for the road and steals a car. Shoot the biker riding towards Lucia, take his bike and follow Jason (pink dot on the minimap), trying not to crash.
After following Jason for some time, a prompt appears for you to jump into his car. You need to ride up close to the car and hold the Square button on Playstation or B on Xbox to jump across.

When you successfully jump to his car, Jason drives while you shoot the pursuing police cars as Lucia; aim for the tires to get rid of the police and crooked cops in style and with ease. After a cutscene, you're driving into Vice City, and Chapter 3 begins with Welcome to Vice City .
Tip: If you die during the bike chase, a bug can make Jason disappear as an objective and leave you with a police search area you can't escape. Restart the mission if that happens.

Tip: You can escape without Lucia, but leaving her behind hurts their relationship. Jason may be short on Zombix and Adrenaline if you haven’t played much with him, so this is a good moment to use any Frag Grenades you picked up.

name: Welcome to Vice City
desc: Jason and Lucia arrive in Vice City and look up Jason's old friend Dre'Quan.

sections.h: Go to the Jack of Hearts
p: Chapter 3 starts seamlessly after Checking Out , as Jason and Lucia drive into Vice City on the highway. After a short drive, Jason calls Dre'Quan , who asks you to meet him at the Jack of Hearts, the Crosstown strip club where he runs a record label.

The car stops outside the club automatically. Talk to the bouncer at the door, then walk around to the entrance on the other side of the building, where Dre'Quan comes out to meet you. Follow him through the club until he stops at the stairs.
Dre'Quan offers you some cash to throw at the dancers. If you accept, walk up to a dancer, focus on her and throw the money.
After having your fun, you need to go back to Dre'Quan at the stairs and follow him up to meet his boss, Boobie Ike , who lets the couple stay in his apartment nearby.

When the conversation is over, return to your car and drive to the apartment nearby. Park in the covered spot: your owned cars will be kept here for the rest of the chapter. Walk around to the front of the building (next time you can use the door opposite the parking spots), go up to the second floor and enter the first door in front of you to finish the mission.
Tip: This mission unlocks the T**s Ass Drug Money trophy / achievement for completing Chapter 2. Afterwards, Moses texts you: Pay 'n' Sprays can now buy and register cars with Standard Trackers.

recompenses: Pay 'n' Sprays and Moses can now take cars with Standard Trackers Unlocked

name: Dealer's Choice
desc: Boobie says Jason owes him a favor for the apartment and sends him on a drug deal with Dre'Quan.

p: Head back to the Jack of Hearts. Go up the stairs and through the door at the top into the studio, then into the recording booth where Dre'Quan is waiting. Wait for him to finish recording; when he asks which hook you like, answer however you want. Then follow him upstairs to Boobie , who tells Jason the apartment comes with a favor.
Get into Dre'Quan's car and drive to an apartment nearby. Follow him to the room on the second floor, where he talks with Tyrone , the dealer; you can interrupt if you don't want to wait.
Cut or Pure product?
Tyrone hints you can make a bit extra selling the cut product, but the buyers notice. You can offer it at half price, and they hand back the product along with the money.
Affects: Mission only
The buyers test it and pay without any trouble.
Affects: Mission only
Follow Dre'Quan back to the car; he takes a detour, and in the big park you get a quick tutorial on throwing a football back to some kids.

Drive to the deal location, a short way south near the Jack of Hearts. Follow Dre'Quan to the group by the cars and hand over the bag when prompted. The buyer takes his time checking the product; you can ask him to hurry up. When he's done, take back the backpack with the money: resolving the deal peacefully gives you a Professional reputation bonus.
On the way back, a man stops you and insists the bag is his. He attacks whatever you say, so knock him out with melee and get in the car.

Drive Dre'Quan down to a shop in Southside. About halfway there, a cutscene takes over: back at the apartment, Cal arrives and tries to crack the hard drive without success, but he mentions that Brian used to have a very capable contact in Vice City who might be able to help.

name: Meet the Heders
desc: Jason and Lucia go on a double date with Brian and Lori Heder.

p: Once Lucia is ready, drive to the restaurant on the east side of Vice City and take the elevator up to Brian and Lori at the bar. You can grab two drinks from the counter and hand one to Lucia before following everyone to the table.
Tip: When the waiter arrives, order the Surf and Turf that Lucia asks for to get a small relationship boost.
After the women leave the table, join Brian at the railing; you can accept or turn down his cigar. When the prompt appears, switch to Lucia.

sections.h: Take the Van to the Dockyard
p: As Lucia, cross the bridge and find the white van in the parking lot on the right. Opening its rear doors puts her in a disguise and behind the wheel. Drive south to the dockyard gate, wait to be let in and park.

Look for the yellow containers marked SCOOP. The one you need sits on top of the stack in the middle. Cut the lock with the new cut-off tool, keeping the moving bar inside the marked section to cut faster.
Tip: The other SCOOP containers can be opened too: the first one holds a cigar and $600 in small boxes.

A gang hauls the container away on a trailer. Jump on one of the nearby bikes, catch up while dodging fire from the back of the truck, and jump onto the trailer when you're close enough. Get in the car and hold the button until it smashes its way out backwards.

sections.h: Lose the Cops and Reach the Lockup
p: The car is very fast, so stay on the highway and avoid crashing until the police give up. Then drive to the lockup in the northwest corner of the city and pull inside. From now on, both Jason and Lucia keep the cut-off tool. Additionally, it is the first time you are introduced in the story to the Nitrous system in cars. You can add it earlier to a car manually, but it is costly. You can press and hold the left stick ( L3 ) to activate it while driving.

recompenses: Cut-off Tool (opens the orange SCOOP containers) Unlocked

name: Dubious Provenance
desc: Jason and Lucia take the statue to an antique store in Capri to find out what it really is.

info.Rewards: Around $2,500 in jewelry and cash + 2 unlocks

sections.h: Go to the Antique Store in Capri
p: Start the mission by interacting with the bag in the closet of the Bayside apartment. Head to Capri on the far west side of the map, by car or with a RideMe to save time. Try the front door of the antique store, and you'll go upstairs automatically.

The owner, Evelyn Andrews , refuses to look at the statue: it's either an incredible fake or stolen, and she wants you gone. Her colleague, the British antiques dealer Benedict Halifax , catches up with you and offers to appraise it off the books, leaving his very valuable watch as collateral.
Do you give Halifax the statue?
Halifax takes the statue and gives you his watch, the Crowex Octane "Bobby Ambrose", which you can wear from the Accessories > Watches menu at a wardrobe.
Affects: Parts 2 and 3
You get an optional objective to call Halifax later and hand it over. If you never do, it disappears at the end of Chapter 3 and you can't play parts 2 and 3.
Affects: Parts 2 and 3
You also get an optional objective to explore Capri together. Visiting any shop or leaving town clears it, and you don't have to do anything there.
Halifax never gets back to you, so return to the antique store in Capri. Time passes until Evelyn leaves. You can break the door down and go in front, but there is another way.

It's quieter to go around the back: take the stairs, jump onto the lower roof and climb in through the window above the air conditioner. Open the door to let Jason in, then check the drawer of the desk in the north corner of the room.

sections.h: Search for Halifax at the Motel
p: You now have the address of the motel right next door. Talk to one of the residents, who points you to an upstairs room on the west side, and knock on the door. After the scene, you choose whether to trust Halifax: trusting him lets you play part 3.

After another silence from Halifax, Evelyn contacts you with information. Go back to the antique store to talk to her, and she gives you the address of a house in the northwest of town where she thinks he is.

Halifax escapes on a boat, and Jason jumps on a Seashark to chase him. Get close and hold the button to jump onto his boat. He crashes and runs off, so swim to shore and keep after him. When he steals a golf cart, grab the bike in the yard and follow. He pepper-sprays Jason and the game switches to Lucia as he runs into her car: jump out, use Focus and shoot him in the leg.
Walk up to Halifax so he stops running, then call Jason on Lucia's phone. When Jason arrives, you get the statue back and choose whether to shoot or spare Halifax; it's up to you.
Tip: Afterwards, loot about $2,500 in jewellery and cash from the storage container, and take the '32 Hustler parked there to keep or sell.

recompenses: Crowex Octane "Bobby Ambrose" watch (if you give Halifax the statue) Unlocked
Around $2,500 in jewelry and cash Cash
'32 Hustler (can be kept or sold) Unlocked

name: Mami Knows Best
desc: Lucia catches up with her mom, Mia, who has just opened her own real estate business.

p: Play as Lucia and head to Peacock Bay to meet her mother, Mia . After talking to her, get in Mia's car and drive to the marked neighborhood in Hamlet, where her first property for sale is.
Follow Mia inside and walk through the rooms while she checks the place out. It's in no condition to sell. Go back near the entrance and help Mia up.

sections.h: Clear the Junk from the Front Lawn
p: Pick up junk items from the front lawn, carry them to the blue dumpster and throw them in. Keep going while Mia is on the phone.

sections.h: Pull the Mattress out of the Pool
p: After the scene, go back to the front door and follow Mia to the backyard. Interact with the mattress and tap the button to help her pull it out of the pool.
An alligator then jumps out and grabs Mia's leg: shoot it quickly to save her. The cutscene will play out, leading to wholesome laughter between mother and daughter.

Members of the M7 gang who live next door confront you at gunpoint and tell you to stay away. Once they leave, Mia suggests getting even: climb into the excavator across the street, drive it to the house and wreck the building and the cars in the driveway. Close the claw to grab the cars and smash them around.
When you've done enough damage, get back in Mia's car and drive to her office nearby to finish the mission.

name: Get Your Wheels
desc: Get yourself a set of wheels in Vice City.

sections.h: Get a Vehicle for Vice City
p: After the escape at the end of Chapter 2, the police recognized Jason’s and Lucia’s cars and had them impounded. You can complete the mission in one of two ways:
Tip: Getting back one character’s car is enough to complete the mission, but both cars were impounded, so you can recover both if you want them.

name: South Leonida Real Estate
desc: Lucia meets up with Mia again and has another run-in with the M7 gang.

info.Rewards: $2,000 from Mia (sent many in-game days later)

p: Mia asks Lucia to meet her at the house again. Drive there from the office, go inside to look for her, then head back out.
Mia is taken away by M7. Jump into her car and tail the kidnappers' vehicle from a distance: if the marker above it starts filling with yellow, you're too close.
The car stops in a back alley blocked by a van. Continue on foot and go through the door on the south side of the alley.

Mia talks her way out by offering to find the M7 boss, Terro, a new headquarters. Drive the group to each property she suggests, carefully, then follow Mia as she gives the tour of the final house all the way to the backyard.
Terro's lieutenant Viper turns up with his own crew and opens fire. You only have the pistol you start with, so pick up weapons from fallen enemies. Clear the backyard, then the front of the house.
Rush back inside, where Viper is holding Mia hostage. While he talks, draw your pistol and shoot him to end the mission.
Tip: Mia's $2,000 commission takes a long time to arrive, but it does come after many in-game days.

recompenses: $2,000 from Mia (sent many in-game days later) Cash

name: Here, Kitty Kitty
desc: Jason goes to see Tyrone and ends up looking for a man named Charles.

p: Tyrone wants Jason to track down a man called Charles, who lives in Rockridge. After reaching his house, you will be presented with two options to get the information on Charles' whereabouts. You can either make a bribe or try to break in on your own. You will need to look for clues in the latter scenario.
How do you find out where Charles is?
Pay the man by the door $20 for a tip (you need the cash on you).
The apartment is empty. Inspect Aline's Thrift Store receipt in the bedroom, and Tyrone gives you an address.

sections.h: Go to the Camp in La Perle
p: Either way, head to the homeless camp on the northwest edge of La Perle and break open the door on the ground floor.
Charles bolts as soon as he sees you. Follow him up the stairs on the far side; if any vagrants attack, knock them out with melee rather than shooting.
At the top floor, Charles goes over the wall. Take the stairs back down and search his body to find a bag of Kitty Litter and complete the mission.

recompenses: Tyrone unlocked as a goods drop-off Unlocked

name: Send Money to Lorena
desc: Send some money to Lorena.

p: There’s nowhere to go for this one: simply open your phone and send the money to Lorena to complete the mission.

name: Car Service
desc: Lucia steals a car for Raul.

p: Raul wants another car stolen. Near the start, the trunk of a car holds flash grenades and a silenced Klose K17 pistol; the silencer is very handy if you want to stay hidden.

The easy way in is to climb the white van on the north side and walk along the metal roof around the yard. Watch the two men loading the van in the middle and the two guards at the gates; more gang members arrive by car if a fight starts.
Tip: A dog usually waits by one of the gate guards. Don't shoot it unless it attacks you: hurting dogs has a big negative effect on your criminal profile.
The car is parked in the middle of the covered area, next to the small room. Get in and leave before the police arrive; if they spot you, lose them first.

sections.h: Deliver It to Leonida Auto World
p: Drive to Leonida Auto World in the far northwest corner of Vice City. Entering the parking lot triggers the final cutscene. Afterwards Randy becomes a vehicle drop-off: he takes cars with standard trackers and items from his request list.

recompenses: Randy unlocked as a vehicle drop-off Unlocked
Wanted areas in Port Gellhorn and Key Lento cleared Unlocked

name: Send More Money to Lorena
desc: Send another payment to Lorena.

p: There’s nowhere to go for this one: simply open your phone and send the money to Lorena to complete the mission. Exact same process, exact same amount, exact same screenshot above.

name: Top Billing
desc: Jason, Lucia and Dre'Quan go to see the Real Dimez in concert.

p: You're taken into the Jack of Hearts automatically. Meet Dre'Quan backstage, down the hallway to the right of the stairs you used in earlier missions.
After the backstage scene, you play as Lucia. Ask the host at the front door: the Dimez have been thrown out. In the parking lot, Bae-Luxe and Roxy are in the middle of an argument.
Roxy speeds off. Hop in the car with the others and follow her until a passing train cuts you off.
Dre'Quan suggests grabbing food instead. Go into Peewees and order for the group at the counter, then head back to Bae-Luxe's car once they decide to go after Roxy.

Drive to the house party south near the VCIA and go in through the back. Jacki is blocking the door to the room where Roxy is. Walk to the kitchen on the other side of the house, where her dog is scratching at the door, and let it out into the yard: Jacki leaves to deal with it.
Inside, Roxy is talking to Kaamal. When he stands up, knock him out with a melee attack to convince Roxy to come with you.
Control switches to Jason outside. Open the green power box on the corner of the sidewalk, look at its left side and flip the switch to black out the house. Then, as Lucia, follow Roxy out to finish.

name: Boobie Time
desc: Jason spends some time driving Boobie around Vice City.

p: Boobie needs a driver for his errands. Follow him out of the club and take the wheel of his car.

The first stop is a few blocks south: wait while Boobie talks to the men in the parking lot. They lean in the car. You can observe the pickups by holding R3 (Right Stick). The camera will pan to inside the car.
The second is a short drive southwest; honk the horn and wait while he talks to the man on the stairs.
Drive south to the center of the city and pull up beside the building by the river.

Thieves grab the bag from the car while you were inside the future club with Bobby taking an imagination tour. Jason follows them on a Seashark. Chase them down the river; they eventually circle around in a dead end while shooting, which makes them easier to hit. Once they're down, ride over the bag to pick it up.
Ride back up the river, get off the Seashark and climb back into Boobie's car.

Drive a short way across the river to the smoke shop and go inside with Boobie, who introduces you to Yasmani . Yasmani becomes a goods drop-off and pays more for jewellery and marked bills than the other fences.

recompenses: Yasmani unlocked as a goods drop-off Unlocked

name: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs
desc: Hit a series of jewelry stores around Vice City and sell the loot to Yasmani.

p: Yasmani wants a specific piece of jewelry from the safe in each of three stores. You can rob them in any order, but deliver the first item to Yasmani straight away: he gives you the Snap Gun, which opens doors without setting off alarms and makes the other two much easier.

Target: a buffalo skull chain. Do this one first, as it has no back door for the Snap Gun and it's the smallest store, so a loud in-and-out is quick. The safe is in the small back office (code 1680 ), and the security box to its left lets you destroy the video footage so the police don't get your description if you escape in time. Smash the display cases for extra jewelry.

Target: a diamond ring. Use the Snap Gun on the back door to slip into the back without alerting the front of the store. Disarm security with the panel to the right of the door into the central room, and wipe the footage at the box under the security screen. The safe is in the northeast corner of the central room (code 6815 ).

Target: an amethyst necklace. Again, the back door can be opened with the Snap Gun. Both the footage and the security system can be dealt with in the small back office. The safe sits halfway along the long back hallway (code 0104 ).
Tip: At Richardson and Donovan Banks, you can leave quietly after the safe, or go into the front of the store and clear out the display cases for more money.
Once you've looted all three stores, go back to Yasmani's shop to sell everything and finish the mission.

recompenses: Extra cash for any other loot you steal Unlocked

name: First Impressions
desc: Jason and Lucia meet Raul for the first time.

p: At the garage on Waxman Island, use the panel on the wall and enter the code 2404 . The game switches to Lucia: get in the car.
Drive to the meeting point on the south side of Ocean Beach . Once Raul is in, the police show up.
As Jason, shoot back while Lucia drives. After the car crashes, keep the officers away from it, then switch back to Lucia: reverse all the way out to the street and keep going.

Tip: To keep a Professional or Hardened criminal rating, aim at tires and engines to wreck the cruisers, and shoot officers in the legs instead of killing them. Shooting drivers works too, but it pushes your rating towards Violent. Watch Jason's health and heal from the inventory if needed.
Drive towards Rialto Islands, between the two halves of the city, while Jason and Raul shoot. Focus on avoiding police cars. Jumping the partly raised bridge shakes off the cops.
Pull into the marked parking lot, get out quickly and take the van parked nearby.
Drive Raul to the drop-off in Bayside. He gets out and the mission ends.

name: Caught Slipping
desc: Jason and Lucia have to stop a burglary.

p: Someone has broken into the apartment. As Jason, chase the first thief through the construction site next door. Draw a gun and use Focus to quickly aim at their legs and stop them.
Run up to the thief and check their bag.
The game switches to Lucia, chasing the other thief. Use the same trick, Focus and a shot to the legs, then search the bag they drop.
Jason and Lucia regroup outside the apartment. Drive south to the Big House Storage building, follow Jason inside and take the elevator up to the storage unit he has bought to complete the mission.

name: Crosstown Traffic
desc: Lucia tails a gang member for Raul, while Jason goes to meet Karim.

p: After the opening scene Jason, on a bike, follows the boats down the river. Stick to the dirt paths along the bank to keep up.
At the drop-off the game switches to Lucia, who just misses her train. Sprint under the elevated tracks shown on the minimap to the next station, climb the stairs and board the rear car.
Walk to the front of the car and intimidate the gang member. Once Lucia has him on the floor, pressure him and take his phone to make him place the call.

As Jason, take out the two shooters on the dock and jump back on the bike. Follow the path ( Karim tells you to turn right at the bridge) until a jump lands you on one of the boats. Shoot the crew of the nearest boat first, then the gunner on the target boat, and jump across when you're close.
Back with Lucia, more gang members attack in the carriage: knock them out with melee, then press the emergency Stop button at the back of the train before it reaches the next station.

Lucia leaps onto the boat while Jason drives. Open the rear seats to take an assault rifle and body armor; ammo is unlimited here. Pick off the drivers of the chasing Seasharks and boats, then the Coast Guard. Shoot the helicopter pilot through the windshield to bring it down at once. The chase ends when Karim drops containers off a bridge to block the pursuers.

name: Credit Check
desc: Raul invites Jason and Lucia to his base to meet his crew.

p: After talking to Raul , go upstairs to Andrea and pick one of the two pairs of masks on the table. Then talk to Karim on the other side of the room and take the Dye Pack Jammer from the desk; from now on you can steal marked bills from banks and Payday Loans stores. Grab stick bombs from the desk next to Karim if you need them.

Leave the building, where Felipe has a car ready, and drive to Fleeca in Washington Beach. Equip your mask from the inventory before going in. Threaten the guards first, then empty the four marked cash drawers behind the counter and drive off.
Tip: If a guard draws a weapon, knock it out of his hand or shoot him in the knees instead of killing him to protect a Professional criminal rating.

Karim marks the next Fleeca branch; steer clear of the police search zone around the first bank. Here the game teaches you to tell your partner to wait in the car for a quick getaway. Go in alone with your mask on, open the back door (Snap Gun or force it, the alarm is off), threaten the teller for the safe code and loot the cash drawer. Blow the inner door with an explosive, then open the small safe with the code or another charge, and run back to the car.

The last and largest branch is further south. Park facing the road for a clean exit and put the mask on again. If one character's bag is full, switch to the other: looting is faster with a single bag. Threaten the many guards quickly, then grab the marked bills from all four drawers.

The alarm goes off and security comes out of the back. Fight your way out; don't bother with the safe, the police are already on their way. Split up with your partner to divide the police, lose them, then return to the Bayside apartment. After a short scene, answer the door to finish.

recompenses: Dye Pack Jammer (lets you steal marked bills) Unlocked
Banks and Payday Loans stores marked as robbery targets Unlocked

name: Steal the Zorrusso for Randy
desc: Jason and Lucia steal a high-end Zorrusso for Randy.

info.Rewards: $21,250 + $10,000 bonus if the car is delivered in good condition + 3 unlocks

p: The car is in the walled parking garage of the Hathaway Apartments in Ocean Beach . Climb over the wall to get in; Jason or Lucia calls Randy automatically.
Randy explains the car has an advanced tracker and sends you the Key Cloner. Open your phone and choose the option to install key_cloner_v1.6.9: it's installed for both characters.
The Zorrusso is on the ground floor, on the east side. Use the door, then the Key Cloner: as with the Slim Jim, push in the right direction when the indicator turns pink to clone the key.

Head to Randy's showroom. The red icon above the minimap is the advanced tracker: if you drive too slowly its bar fills and your position is sent to the police. Near the showroom the icon turns grey and the tracker switches off. Drive around the lot and into the garage.
Tip: Bring the car in without damage for a $10,000 bonus; otherwise Randy just makes fun of your driving.

Follow Randy to the board, where he explains his Wish List of rare cars. Their locations start unknown: find them yourself or ask Randy for tips one at a time. The deliveries are optional but needed for the Supply & Demand trophy.

recompenses: $10,000 bonus if the car is delivered in good condition Cash
Key Cloner (lets you steal high-end cars) Unlocked

name: Race Against Yago
desc: Take on Yago in a race. Time-sensitive and missable.

info.Rewards: Prize money based on your finishing position ($3,800 for first place)

p: This mission only stays available for a short time after Yago 's message, so head to the meet in Salton as soon as you get it.
Talk to Santiago and choose the second race, Freeway Run. Rent a car and finish the race; the prize depends on your position, up to $3,800 for a win.
Tip: Race Against Yago is missable: if the hourglass runs out, the mission disappears. It doesn't affect trophies or 100% completion.

recompenses: Prize money based on your finishing position ($3,800 for first place) Cash

name: Sinfrontera National Bank
desc: Jason and Lucia scope out a bank as preparations for a big heist begin.

p: Once Credit Check is done, Raul gets in touch and asks you to meet him at Sinfrontera National Bank in Tequesta, where the La Polilla Negra cartel launders its money. Climb the main stairs and walk in through the front entrance.
You control Lucia here. Stay with Jason, walk to the table nearby and interact with it so the two of you lean on it and blend in with the customers.

Turn on Focus to highlight the points of interest and hold the inspect button on each one: the cameras above the counter, the man in the pink suit standing just behind Jason, the two guards next to the elevators and the security panel between the two elevators.
When everything has been checked, Raul calls you upstairs. Join him and Andrea and sit down on the chair to end the mission. Their next step is to find Nicole Park , the bank's security expert.

name: Security Expert
desc: Jason and Lucia meet a security expert who could help with the heist.

p: The mission begins as soon as Sinfrontera National Bank ends and takes you to Waning Sands to look for Nicole Park . Head south through the neighborhood to the marked house and drive past it slowly, as Jason tells you, then park the car nearby.

Move toward the house on foot and stay behind Jason, who shows you the way around the back. Wait for the guard to come out of the back door and walk off, then slip inside while Jason keeps watch. Cross the hallway to the bedrooms and open the closed door of the one in the northeast corner.
After the cutscene Nicole is unconscious: pick her up. Follow Jason out of the back door and along the side of the house to the front, then open the trunk of your car and put her inside.
Tip: Stay right on Jason's heels while you carry Nicole and the guards won't notice you.

sections.h: Bring Her to the Planning Room
p: Leave the area quickly before the guards react, then drive to the planning room in Stockyard to complete the mission. There Raul tells Nicole he knows she has been stealing from La Polilla Negra, and she agrees to join the crew.

name: Heist Planning
desc: Raul is assembling a crew to rob the Sinfrontera National Bank, and there’s plenty of prep work to do first.

p: Heist Planning isn’t a mission with its own objectives: it’s an entry in the mission list that tracks your progress towards The Cartel Heist . Its in-game card simply reads “Complete prep work” and explains that Raul is putting together a crew to rob the Sinfrontera National Bank, and that you need to follow his plan and get ready for the job.

It appears after Sinfrontera National Bank and Security Expert , and stays on your list while you work through the preparation missions for the robbery: Company Property , Safe Word , The Missing Link and Hidden Charges . Once all the prep is done, Raul gets in touch to start The Cartel Heist .
Tip: There’s nothing to do for Heist Planning itself: just play the prep missions as they show up on the map and it will be completed along the way.

name: Ride or Die
desc: Jason helps out Dre'Quan.

sections.h: Meet Dre'Quan at the Jack of Hearts
p: About a day after Credit Check , Dre'Quan texts Jason and asks to meet at the Jack of Hearts. Go there alone as Jason and sit on the ledge outside the club until he comes out. He wants revenge on DWNPLY, and the plan is to steal his car.

sections.h: Get a Pair of DWNPLY Sneakers
p: Drive to the Eris store on the Downtown waterfront and go in with Dre'Quan. Upstairs, to the right of the DJ, a man with a bag offers the sneakers for $1,580. You can pay, or try to haggle: he refuses and walks away. Follow him outside, pick up a basketball from the stand on the right and throw it at him so he drops the bag, then grab it.
Tip: The basketball trick gets you the sneakers for free and saves you $1,580.
Go back to Dre'Quan, who waits just inside the door, and follow him upstairs. When the bouncer blocks you, look at him and pick Show Shoes to be let in without paying.

DWNPLY sits with a group to the left of the bar. Walk up to him and Jason hands over the sneakers. While he signs them, hold the button to reach for his keys; he stops to ask who the signature is for, so answer and then keep holding until Jason has the keys.

Run downstairs after Dre'Quan and out to the parking lot. Use the car horn button and follow the sound to the east side of the lot, where the car sits in one of the lit VIP spaces. Get in and wait for Dre'Quan.

As soon as you leave the lot a gang member jumps on the hood: swerve left and right to throw him off. If DWNPLY's bodyguard and the Cash City gang follow you, get out of the red area on the map to lose them, then drive to the Stockyard Speedshop to finish.

name: Company Property
desc: Jason and Lucia meet Brian and help with a weapons shipment.

p: After Security Expert , go to Skeeter's in the south of Hamlet. Raul has asked Brian to return a favor: he has arranged a weapons delivery from his old smuggling contact, Pilot Pete . Talk to Brian at the bar, follow him outside and get in his truck.

Drive to the airfield south of Hamlet and wait for Pete's plane. Pete hands a crate to Jason and Lucia: carry it to the back of Brian's truck, then pick up another crate from the ground and load that one too.

IAA agents and cops raid the airfield. Lucia leaves with Brian and you take control of Jason. Follow Pete through the garage door on the right into the hangar, where you find an assault rifle and health items opposite the door. Fight the agents who come in, then follow Pete out of the back, down the road to the south and up onto a rooftop, where you can shoot the cars coming down the road.

Keep following Pete through the trees and across the runway to the other hangar, watching for cars coming from the far side. Jason jumps into the plane with Pete: drive out of the hangar, turn left down the runway at full speed and pull up as early as you can.

The game switches to Lucia in the back of Brian's truck with an LMG and unlimited ammo. Shoot the vehicles before they ram the truck, because every hit can knock cargo boxes off. Reload only when nothing is right behind you.
Tip: The cargo you save decides how many explosives you get in Hidden Charges , and keeping all of it also earns a Professional bonus.

After Lucia gets into the car, follow the road objective until you switch back to Jason. The plane is too damaged to fly on, so aim for the colorful field to the right of the river and bring it down there to end the mission.

recompenses: Up to 3 explosive charges for Hidden Charges (depends on how much cargo you save) Unlocked

name: The Missing Link
desc: Lucia meets Andrea, and the trail leads her to a cockfight.

p: After Company Property , go to Sloppy Molly's in Watson Bay alone as Lucia. Andrea has set up a meeting with Monty, a high-ranking La Polilla Negra enforcer, at an illegal cockfight. Once Lucia has changed, follow Andrea across the street into the warehouse.

Wait inside while Andrea texts her contact. When prompted, join her at the north door next to the bouncer in the white suit, then follow her to the back to meet Monty. Go into the back room when he asks: he wants photos for the cartel's social media, so switch poses left and right and take the pictures.
After the photos the meeting turns into a fistfight. Beat Monty until he is knocked out.

Shoot your way through the building so Andrea can carry Monty out. Watch the doorways and corners, and in the big room where the cockfight was held, look out for more gunmen driving in through the garage on the right.
Tip: Kill the first enemy, then go back into the photo room before moving on: Monty's pistol is on the floor there. It's a variant weapon you can only get this way.

Lucia and Andrea throw Monty into a car outside: get in and head for the marker in Vice City. Ignore the gang members on your tail, you lose them soon after leaving Hamlet. About halfway there the game asks you to switch to Jason.

As Jason, meet Lucia and Andrea at the front of the building, pull Monty out of the trunk and walk him to the backyard at gunpoint. Knock him down when Raul tells you to, then use the loader to swing Monty over the alligator pool and raise or lower him as Raul asks his questions. Don't drop him all the way into the water or he dies.
Tip: Getting through every question without killing Monty earns a Professional bonus.
When Raul has what he needs, decide Monty's fate: set him down on dry land or drop him into the pool for the alligator. The mission ends either way.

recompenses: Monty’s pistol (variant weapon, only if you pick it up during the mission) Unlocked

name: Safe Word
desc: Lucia steals a practice safe and learns a new skill.

p: After Company Property , go back to Raul 's compound in Stockyard and speak to Nicole . She knows which safe the bank uses and wants Lucia to practice on a smaller model of it, which a pornographer called Gil keeps in his mansion. Take the big truck parked outside and drive to Peacock Estates, at the far south of the city.

You switch to Jason. Crouch, go through the front gate and move along the right side of the house through the archway. A woman comes out of a door and stops you, so you have to blend in: follow Gil's assistant to the backyard, where a film shoot is under way.

After makeup, go to the pool and pick up the skimmer, then move it back and forth until you are told to stop. Follow the prompts: look at Samantha on the lounger, pick up the lotion and spread it on Sasha's back. When Rodney steps in, hit him a few times, then stop and let him hit you, and finally keep punching him until he is knocked out.
Participate further in the shoot?
Jason stays in the scene a little longer.
Jason walks away and goes after the safe.

Run around the house to the door you couldn't get through before. Inside, go through the first double doors and then the closed doors on the right side of the hallway into Gil's office. Open the drawer on the left side of the desk to find the remote that reveals the safe.
Lucia backs the truck up to the house. Open the window, attach the winch to the safe, then, as Lucia, hold the button until the safe is dragged out of the house.

Drive west to Felipe 's garage with the safe dragging behind. Steer left and right to swing it into the cars chasing you, including the police. Avoid the cyclists Jason warns you about and the gravestones in the cemetery: hitting them gives you a Psycho criminal rating. Drive into the garage to drop off the safe.

Back at Raul's compound you can practice on the safe as many times as you like. It's worth it: the mechanics are the same as in the big heist at the end of the chapter. First drill: hold the drill at the right position, keep the right gauge steady and adjust as the left one rises, and don't let the drill light turn red. Then guide the cable through the door without touching the cable itself or the walls, and hook the gold ring at the end. Finally, hold the triggers and mash the button to hold the door while Nicole drills and enters the combination. Quit the practice when you're done to complete the mission.
Tip: Opening the practice safe gives you Gil's Kalinga .50, a variant pistol, and $1,500 from inside the safe.

recompenses: Gil’s Kalinga .50 (variant pistol, for opening the practice safe) Unlocked

name: Cooties
desc: Lucia helps shoot a music video.

p: A couple of in-game days after Ride or Die , Dre'Quan calls about shooting the music video for the Dimez 's song "Cooties", starring DWNPLY's stolen car. Go to the marker in Crosstown.

Most of the shoot is scripted and you play as Lucia. In the driving parts, hold the accelerator to keep the car moving and use the stick to drift around the circle. When the car stops, get out, pull the man off Roxy and fight the other one who comes at you. After the girls smash the car, Lucia gets a bat and can join in. To finish, shake the spray can and paint the side of the car.
DWNPLY and his friends turn up. Drive off and keep going until every car chasing you is gone and you are out of the red area on the map.
Take the car to the studio to complete the mission.

name: Pick Up Shayna
desc: Someone needs Lucia to pick them up. Time-sensitive and missable.

info.Rewards: Up to about $6,500 in stolen goods and drugs to fence

p: Drive through or near Hamlet as Lucia and Shayna , a friend from prison who is about to be released, texts her asking for a ride. Go to the prison to pick her up.
Tip: This mission is only available for a limited time. It isn’t required for 100%, but if you want it, do it as soon as it is marked on the map.

Drive Shayna to her boyfriend Raph’s house in Southside and follow her inside. While she argues with him, walk around the house and grab about $1,500 worth of valuables, for example from the kitchen table and the bedroom on the right.
Shayna pulls a gun on Raph: what do you say?
The better choice to start with.
Raph is killed straight away.
Some gang members walk in and shoot Raph. You can talk them down so they leave peacefully, leaving you drugs worth about $1,200, or shoot all three of them right away.

If you took out the gang, Shayna keeps half of the drugs and lets you have the other half, worth about $5,000 to sell: the biggest possible payout. Leave quickly before the police spot you to complete the mission.

recompenses: Up to about $6,500 in stolen goods and drugs to fence Cash

name: Bricked Up
desc: Jason and Lucia do some work for Boobie.

info.Rewards: $3,500 (only if you take Boobie’s bricks on the way out)

p: Once Hidden Charges and the other remaining Chapter 3 main missions are done, Boobie gets in touch and you find him asleep in Jason and Lucia's Bayside apartment. As long as they live there they work for him, and he sends them to collect some bricks of cocaine that a gang called San4San owes him.
Drive to Venture Apartments in Rockridge. Lucia suggests parking out of sight: leave the car outside the red area on the map, or it gets impounded during the mission. Walk to the front entrance.
In the lobby turn right and talk to the man by the elevator. Upstairs, walk down the hallway and knock on the red door with the slot in the middle.

Captain Méndez and his dirty cops raid the building and you have to fight your way out with just your pistols, so pick up any longarms the police drop. Before you leave the first room, grab the red bag near the end of the table: these are Boobie's bricks. Work back down the hallway toward the elevators, watching the side doors and the large room before them, then take the stairs at the end of the hallway or the elevator; if it stops, mash the button to force the doors open.
Tip: Taking the red bag earns a Professional bonus and $3,500 from Boobie at the end. On the dark third floor, a police gun with a flashlight makes enemies much easier to spot.

Fight down through the third and second floors. At the end of the last hallway Raymond points you into the apartment on his left. Lucia climbs out of the window: help her drop down, then as Lucia run to the parking lot to the south, take a car and drive back under the window to pick up Jason.

A police helicopter is on you from the start, so it takes a while: get as far from the building as you can and look out for roadblocks. When you're clear, drive to the Jack of Hearts, where Boobie waits in his car out front. Stay outside the police search area on the way; you can change cars if you like.

recompenses: $3,500 (only if you take Boobie’s bricks on the way out) Cash

name: Hidden Charges
desc: Jason and Lucia get the explosives ready for the heist.

sections.h: Meet Karim at the Planning Room
p: The mission shows up on the map as "Prepping the Explosives" after Company Property , but Karim only calls you in once Cooties and most of the other main missions are done. At the planning room in Stockyard he explains the plan: blowing up key cell towers in Vice City will cause a distraction and cut the bank's emergency communications. Jason and Lucia also tell Raul about Tomas and the hard drive, and he promises to help them after the job.
Get in the van Karim is loading with explosives and drive to the marker downtown. Park inside the marked garage in the alley.

Tip: You can plant the charges with one character or split the work between Jason and Lucia. Using both is quicker, because you don't have to run back to the van each time, and it also raises their relationship.

You have up to three charges: one fewer for each cargo box lost in Company Property. You can do the towers in any order, but the East tower is right above the van. Go to the front of the building to the west, the one with the helipad on the map, and take the elevator to the roof. Climb the stairs to the helipad, cross the walkway to the next rooftop, climb up to the tower and plant the charge.
Switch to the other character, who is already near the South tower. Walk past the pool to the elevator, ride it to the roof, climb the ladder and plant the charge on the tower.

If you still have a third charge, pick the character who will place it: switching puts you right back at the van, which is a bit faster. Grab the bag and go to the building on the north side. It's a construction site and the workers report you for trespassing straight away, so move fast: the elevator is inside on the left. On the roof, go around the far side of the grey tower, climb the ladder and plant the charge on the box.
Leave the area once the last charge is set. Take a parachute from the box on the rooftop if you don't have one, jump off and glide away, then get out of the police search area to finish the mission.
Tip: Every charge you plant gives you more time during The Cartel Heist .

recompenses: Extra time in The Cartel Heist (depends on how many charges you plant) Unlocked

name: The Cartel Heist
desc: The plan is set and it is time to hit the bank.

p: When Hidden Charges and the rest of Chapter 3 are done, Raul calls the crew to the planning room in Stockyard. After the briefing, get in the black car outside with Lucia and Nicole and drive downtown toward the cell towers you rigged. Park in the marked spot by the road and set off the charges.

Drive south to Sinfrontera National Bank : the clock is now running, and with all three towers down you have almost 11 minutes before the police are free. Walk into the lobby and wait for Karim 's signal, then knock out one of the marked guards. Threaten each marked customer and employee so they move to the middle of the room, including the ones in the side rooms. Deal first with anyone Karim says is heading for the door.
Tip: If a guard pulls a gun, shoot it out of his hand rather than killing him to keep your Professional rating.

The game switches to Lucia. Take the open elevator with Raul and Nicole and, on the vault floor, threaten Lex until he walks into the security room. Keep the pressure on until he opens the door for the truck, then knock him out once he moves to the wall.

sections.h: Clear the Building and the Roof
p: Back as Jason upstairs, take down the La Polilla Negra security guards coming out of the elevators and from the upper floor. Go to the second floor and ride the elevator to the roof. The guards there are watching the helicopter at first, so you get the first shots. Clear the roof, climb the ladder to the upper level and secure the backup terminal.

As Lucia, open the vault with the same three steps you practiced in Safe Word . This time both drill bars move, so keep adjusting both. With the cable camera, the line is behind a very sharp turn to the right: follow it to the gold hook at the end. Then hold the door steady while Nicole drills it open. Run inside and bag the big stacks of bills first, as they're worth far more than the loose cash around the room.

As Jason, hold the second floor against the cops pouring into the lobby and the SWAT officers breaching your floor. Swap the shotgun for a longer-range weapon. Then, as Lucia, cover the left side of the building. When prompted, regroup with Raul in the middle of the room. A SWAT truck reverses into the lobby and throws a flashbang: stay in cover until you can see again, then finish off the enemies left.

Run to the back of the SWAT truck: Lucia climbs in and throws Jason a smoke grenade launcher. Go outside and fire smoke at the police cars in front of the bank, then, as Lucia, run out through the front door to the bus.

As Jason, shoot the enemies rushing in at the front and help Nicole up. Follow her through the door the enemies came from, turn right straight away to the stairs and head down to the basement, watching for a flashbang on the landing. Keep going down, take the door on the left when Nicole points it out to reach the delivery bay, and follow the driveway out. Get into the Brigade SWAT vehicle at the top of the ramp and drive away once Nicole is in.

As Lucia on the bus, shoot the pursuing vehicles through the back and listen to Raul, who warns you when cars come up on either side. After a truck rips the roof off, Raul hands you a grenade launcher with unlimited ammo: use it on the rest of the chase. A helicopter then follows you. It is easiest to hit with a grenade once it sits right behind the bus, or you can switch weapons and use Focus to shoot the pilot.

Back as Jason in the armored truck, chase down the bus, ramming police cars out of the way, and pull up on its left side to jump across. Drive the bus along the freeway and keep left when Raul tells you to. After the final scene you can hang around or go straight on to Ocean Beach , the first mission of Chapter 4.

name: Ocean Beach
desc: Jason and Lucia set up shop in Ocean Beach.

p: After The Cartel Heist you can go straight back to the Bayside apartment, or start the mission the next time you return there. Jason and Lucia pack up their things and leave the apartment for good.
Head to the Y Hotel on the Vice Beach side of the city. The valet takes your car at the entrance, so just walk inside.

Valentina is waiting on the right side of the lobby. The suite is part of her money laundering operation: she introduces you to Santino , the concierge, and promises to set up a meeting with Abraham Gonzalez, a well-known Vice City lawyer who can help Jason and Lucia start new lives. Follow her to the elevator.
Ride the elevator to the 7th floor, turn left and walk to the far end of the hallway to reach room 701.
Look around the new place while Lucia opens up each room. When she opens the bedroom, interact with the wardrobe: new outfits are available from this chapter on.
Keep following Lucia until she steps out onto the balcony and mentions the champagne. Go back inside, take two glasses from the counter and bring one out to her to finish the mission.

recompenses: Room 701 at the Y Hotel (new home) Unlocked

name: Another Life
desc: Lucia thinks back on her past.

p: The mission begins right after Ocean Beach , when the game switches to Lucia. It is a flashback to her last morning with Tomas and the hours before she was arrested. Start by picking up the phone on the table.
Walk to the room at the end of the hallway and pick Tomas up from his crib.
Carry him back to the living room and interact with the things there to calm him down. When prompted, turn up the radio on the counter.
Follow the prompts to dance around the living room with Tomas. A few more cutscenes follow, then the mission ends and the Vice City, Baby! trophy unlocks.

recompenses: BuckMe Black account ($2,000,000 account limit) Cash

name: Pool Day
desc: Time for a day at the pool.

p: Pool Day starts right after Another Life , when you switch back to Jason in the Y Hotel suite. It isn't marked like a normal mission: go out to the balcony to talk to Lucia (if you try to leave the suite, she calls you back) and agree to go down to the pool.
Once you've settled at the cabana, get up and walk past the pool on the right to the bar to order Lucia a Tequila Sunrise.

On the way back, a man called Eddie Acosta stops you and invites you to a party. You can accept or decline, but you're invited either way, and the optional mission Attend Eddie Acosta's Party appears on the map for later.

Bring Lucia her drink, then sit down with her and people-watch. Look at the man floating on the inflatable flamingo and guess what he does for a living, then at the group on the left, where one of them looks like Cal , and finally at the woman with the big hat sitting at the edge of the pool on the right.
When Lucia gets up, follow her out to the beach to end the mission. Valentina calls soon after, and the next two missions appear on the map.

name: Attend Eddie Acosta's Party
desc: Eddie Acosta is throwing a party, and you're invited.

p: At the start of Chapter 4, speak to Lucia on the balcony of your Y Hotel room and agree to go to the pool to start Pool Day . While you're at the bar, a crypto fan called Eddie Acosta strikes up a conversation.

A few days after Pool Day , Eddie texts you a party invite and the building is marked in central Vice City. Go as either Jason or Lucia, but alone. You call Eddie automatically when you walk into the lobby.
Eddie steps out of the elevator and talks up his crypto project on the ride up. As soon as you step onto the rooftop he locks you out: the party is a setup, and he demands a $50,000 "investment".
Pay Eddie the $50,000?
He unlocks the door and joins you outside, but all you get is a worthless NFT sent to your phone.

Turn him down in the conversation, or shoot at him (the door is bulletproof). To get off the roof, ride the bike at full speed over the solar panels to jump to the next roof, then take the elevator down.

If you didn't shoot at him, Eddie comes out to talk after your jump, then waits by the lobby elevator for his next mark. You can confront him there and he flees through the front door. If you fired at him, he runs off right away. Eddie has only this one mission, and it doesn't count toward Strangers & Freaks.

name: Company Cars
desc: Jason and Lucia pick up some new wheels.

p: After Pool Day , go down to the Y Hotel lobby and talk to Santino , the concierge. The marker may still show a lock right after Pool Day, but you can start the mission anyway. Valentina has arranged new cars for Jason and Lucia: tell Santino you want to go now and the hotel's car service drives you straight to Status Auto Imports.
Tip: The hotel car service works as a free taxi you can call from the front of the Y Hotel at any time.
Inside the dealership, talk to the salesman who is arguing with another man next to the red car, then follow Rob to the cars on the other side of the showroom.
Tip: The showroom is full of high-end cars you can scan with the WAiNK app for your collection.

Choose a car for Jason first, then one for Lucia: get in the driver's seat of the one you want and confirm. The Pfister Comet S2 has the best base stats if you want something fast, while the truck or the SUV make a more balanced pair. Both cars are yours afterwards, so you can upgrade, customize or sell them freely.

sections.h: Race Back to the Y Hotel
p: Outside, chase after Lucia until she challenges you to a race back to the Y Hotel. Damage doesn't matter, since the cars are yours, but Lucia will tease you about it. Reach the hotel to finish the mission.

recompenses: A new car for Jason and one for Lucia from Status Auto Imports Unlocked

name: Lawyer Up
desc: Jason and Lucia meet a lawyer, Abe Gonzalez.

p: After Pool Day , Valentina calls to say she has found a lawyer for Jason and Lucia. Drive to Abe Gonzalez 's office in Downtown Vice City.
Talk to the receptionist, then walk to the back of the office to meet Abe's assistant, Sandy.

Go upstairs to Abe's office. He agrees to start working on their legal problems in exchange for a favor. While Jason is out of the room, Abe tells Lucia her situation would be far easier to fix if she gave Jason up, but she refuses. The mission ends after the cutscene.

name: Party Hard
desc: Jason and Lucia work personal security for a celebrity.

p: After Lawyer Up , Valentina offers a security job to pay for the lawyer: protecting telenovela star Andrés de León at the opening of the Megamundo Network headquarters. Meet her at VCIA, then drive Andrés out of the airport behind the lead car.
Andrés wants a drink on the way, so stop at the marked spot in Little Cuba to pick up his order, then drive to the Megamundo offices in Downtown.
Follow Andrés into the building and, after the lobby scene, follow Petra and the others into the elevator. Upstairs, go to the marked conference room to check on Andrés.

Gunmen from the FAP storm the building and take Andrés away. Knock the gun out of the hand of the attacker left in the room and knock him out, then fight through the hallway, clear the floor and pick up the radio from the marked body.
As Lucia, crouch along the left side of the room to the stairwell. Mash the prompts to fight off the man who jumps you, kick his gun away and, when prompted, hit him with the shoe on the floor.

Back as Jason, keep fighting the attackers while following the floor around to the left; enemies come out of the offices. Take the stairs up when it's clear. As Lucia, shoot the man in the elevator, climb the stairs to the hole in the wall and crawl through the vent until you drop down onto the party floor.

Take out every gunman on the party floor. Your silenced pistol has no spare ammo, so make each shot count, and use Focus while not aiming to highlight nearby enemies. If you get spotted or fire a loud gun, everyone comes looking for you, so be careful not to hit the hostages below. When the floor is clear, go downstairs, untie Valentina and check on the Navarros hiding behind the marked door.
Tip: Pick off enemies one at a time from cover with the silenced pistol: getting spotted turns the whole floor against you.
As Jason, sprint to the rooftop and jump onto the helicopter as it takes off. Mash the prompts to fight the kidnappers, dodge their attacks and kick them out, then pull Andrés back inside.
Take the controls, fly back to Megamundo HQ and land on the rooftop helipad to complete the mission.

name: Heavy Lifting
desc: Jason and Lucia have a delivery to make.

p: Shortly after Lawyer Up , Raul asks Jason and Lucia to bring him the hard drive. Go to the storage building, take the elevator up and grab it from the locker.

Drive to Leonard County, where Raul's houseboat is docked, and take the stairs on the right to the upper deck where Karim is waiting. Raul wants to rob a rival crew led by Kordell Grant , a bodybuilder he once worked with, and needs intel on their next job.
You end up on a boat: sail south to Ajax Gym and pull up at the nearby dock. Lucia goes in first; as Jason, talk to the receptionist in the blue tank top and follow J-Wang on his tour of the gym.
Back at reception the game switches to Lucia. Change into your gym outfit at the marked locker, then quickly search Raina's backpack in the locker to the left.

Head upstairs to the main gym. As Jason on the treadmill, keep tapping the button to hold the pace; as Lucia, use the leg extension machine. When Kordell's crew leaves, go to the tanning salon with Jason.

While Jason distracts the employee, slip into the tanning rooms: Nate is in the second room on the right. Pick up the lifting strap from the floor and use it on the tanning bed to lock Nate inside. Search his bag, open the WhatUp app on his phone and read his messages, then put the phone away and let Nate out.

Leave the gym (you can change back into your clothes first) and meet Jason by the water. At night you follow the bodybuilders by car: stay far enough back that the marker above them stays white, because it fills up yellow when you get too close. It's a long drive that ends at the Grand Majestic Aparthotel.
Tip: If the marker starts turning yellow, ease off the accelerator and let another car get between you and the bodybuilders.

Follow them into the hotel and watch them take an elevator. Walk up to the elevators, where Jason calls another one, ride it to the top floor and follow the hallway out onto the roof to finish the mission. Meanwhile Karim has found out that the hard drive belonged to Giorgio Gallo , heir to the Bilgeco shipping company.

name: It's a Date!
desc: Time for a date night.

p: Right after Heavy Lifting , a date for Jason and Lucia is marked on the map at the Courtyard Bar in Stockyard, Vice City. Head there with both of them together.
Walk into the bar area and buy a drink. You can also hang around and dance for a while if you like. The date ends as soon as you leave the bar and walk back out to the street.
Tip: It’s one of the shortest missions in the game, and skipping it has no consequences, but it’s a quick and easy relationship boost for Jason and Lucia.

name: Photo/Shoot
desc: Jason, Lucia and Dre'Quan shoot a promo.

p: After Party Hard , Dre’Quan gets in touch because he needs a hand with a promo shoot for the Dimez . Head to the marked building in Tequesta, follow him into the elevator and up onto the roof.
When the helicopter lifts off you take control of Lucia. Bring up the phone camera and snap pictures of the Dimez while they strike different poses inside the chopper.

Things go wrong in the lobby: Dre’Quan is grabbed by Cash City and driven away. As Jason, fly the helicopter after the car. When it disappears inside a building, switch to Lucia, who follows on a bike at street level. You can’t shoot the kidnappers’ car, so just keep it in sight.
Tip: After the second jump more cars join the chase: these ones you can shoot, so take them out before they ram or shoot you.

Walk up to the gang and fight your way through to Dre’Quan. Under the highway, watch for reinforcements arriving by car on the right and others coming out of the garage doors on the left. Clear the alley and reach the car at the end to finish the mission.

name: Bad Driver!
desc: Track down Felipe.

p: Once you have finished Party Hard , Andrea tells you that Felipe , who ran out on the Cartel heist, has been spotted in Millport. Drive to the marked bar and walk towards the back: Felipe comes out of the restroom and bolts.
Tip: Bad Driver! is missable: if you start Power Play before doing it, the mission is gone for good.
He runs out the back towards the woods. You can shoot him in the legs or back to slow him down, then catch up and hit him so he gives up.
Focus on Felipe to question him about why he bailed. You decide what happens next.
Kill Felipe or let him go?
Shoot him at any point during the conversation.
Choose to let him go through the dialogue options.

recompenses: Collect Felipe's Gift optional mission (if you spare him) Unlocked

name: Making Gainz
desc: Raul has a plan, and Lucia hits the gym to get to know someone new.

info.Featuring: Dre'Quan Priest Francisco Delgado Kordell Grant Nate

p: A couple of in-game days after Heavy Lifting , Raul contacts Lucia about the next step of his plan. Go to the planning room with Lucia alone to start the mission.

Tip: From this point Jason and Lucia can’t be seen together in public until VCIA Takedown : they can only hang out in their room at the Y Hotel. If you like spending time with both of them, do any couple activities before starting Making Gainz, or play the next story missions back to back.
After the cutscene you arrive at Ajax Gym. Go upstairs to the main workout area and find Nate by the weight benches. Talk to him a few times until he finally pays attention to Lucia.

Use the bench press he is standing behind, then follow him to the squat rack and finally outside to the deadlift area, completing each workout. When Nate leaves with Kordell , use the free exercise bike on the other side of the pool.
A long montage follows, with Lucia training alongside Nate over several weeks and scenes of Jason with Dre’Quan in between. Keep completing the workouts and talking to Nate as it goes on.
Take the steroids Nate offers?
This is the default answer.
You have to actively pick this option.

When the montage is over and Nate has shown Lucia the Trauma Floor, Kordell’s private workout area, leave the gym and meet Jason around the north side of the building. As Jason, drive to the planning room and use the intercom to go in.

sections.h: Earn the Crew’s Trust on the Trauma Floor
p: Back at the gym as Lucia, change into workout clothes at the locker on the right of the Trauma Floor and talk to Nate. Then train next to the bodybuilders: first near Raina, then near Nate and Francisco , and finally use the deadlift on the stage where Kordell is. When Kordell comes over to chat, answer however you like, talk to the rest of the crew and leave the gym to complete the mission.

name: Too Much Baggage
desc: Jason scopes out the airport and does some baggage handling.

p: After Making Gainz , Raul decides Jason will help scope out Vice City International Airport. Drive there, talk to the guard and park inside the lot, then walk to the nearby office to meet Andrea .
Omar, the head baggage handler, drives Jason into the airport. In first person, look at every white box highlighted by the glasses until it turns green: these are points of interest for Karim .
Follow Omar, get on the baggage tug and reverse it into the two trailers to attach them. Then drive to the plane in the southern part of the airport.

Throw the bags to Omar so he can stack them on the trailer. Hold the button to fill the power bar and release it a little before it reaches the middle section, because the bar keeps moving slightly after you let go.

Make an excuse to leave Omar, exit the bay and follow the wall south to the last double doors on the left. Inside, follow the left wall into the hallway and through the blue door to the security office, then go into the restroom on your right and plant the device behind the toilet.
Leave the restroom to return to Omar. When he talks to you, focus on him and tell him you want the job to complete the mission.

name: Watch It
desc: Jason and Dre'Quan meet a club owner.

p: After Making Gainz , Dre’Quan wants Jason’s help to impress the owner of a nightclub. Go to the marked store, head upstairs and wait for Dre’Quan to finish with the clerk, then follow him back to the car.
Drive south to the Cruda parking lot, take the ramps up to the top floor and park next to the marked car, where the guys who sold Dre’Quan the watch are waiting.

The meeting turns into a brawl: help Dre’Quan knock the two men out. Then a car full of gunmen arrives and opens fire straight away, followed by more enemies from the stairs. Take them all down, get back in your car and leave before the police show up.
Dre’Quan wants new clothes, so drive to Nola near the southern end of Ocean Beach . Choose one of the two outfits on the mannequins: he pays for it and takes the other one.
Drive north to the Doight d’Or hotel and follow Dre’Quan through the building and out the back. The mission ends after his talk with Royce Jones, the owner of the VYB nightclub.

name: Cash Injections
desc: Lucia hangs out with Nate and helps out an associate.

p: After Amateur Hour , Nate texts Lucia asking her to call him so they can hang out. You can call him yourself, or wait about a day until he calls her. Then go to the Muscle Beach gym on Ocean Beach to meet him.

Nate wants backup while he sells Synthol. Follow him off the beach to his car, get in and drive a few blocks north to the back alley where the deal takes place. When he asks, open the trunk to grab the bag.
The buyers turn on you: press the prompt to knock the gun out of the hand of the man next to you, then take out the enemies around Nate while one of them drives off in Nate’s car.
Jump into the car left in the alley and follow the thief. You can’t stop the driver by shooting him here, so just stay on his tail.

The car stops in the alley of a motel and several gunmen get out. Clear the area to reach Nate’s car in the parking lot, watching for enemies on the motel’s upper floor and coming out of the side doors.
Drive out of the area straight away; if the police spot you, lose them first. Nate then offers Lucia an ice cream: drive to the shop in the northern part of Vice Beach to complete the mission.

name: Amateur Hour
desc: Lucia helps Cisco confront a director.

p: After your first workout with the crew, go back to Ajax Gym as Lucia. On the Trauma Floor, talk to Francisco , who is deadlifting on the stage. Cisco wants help with a porn director who owes him money, and Lucia sees a chance to win him over.

sections.h: Change and Go to Cisco’s Car
p: Change into a different outfit at Lucia’s locker, then follow Cisco out of the back door of the Trauma Floor to his car.
Drive a short way north to the pick-up spot on Washington Island and park in the marked place. Sit on the nearby bench while Cisco hides, and wait for the camper to show up.
Jump back into Cisco’s car and chase the camper. Cisco opens fire, and you can shoot too.
Tip: Aim for the tyres: once they are blown out the camper stops almost immediately.

sections.h: Get the Money and Drive Back
p: When the camper stops, Judd climbs out and Cisco gets his money back. Drive Cisco back to the rear of Ajax Gym and park the car in his spot to complete the mission.

name: Dirty Work
desc: Jason and Lucia deal with Raina and make some new inroads.

p: Once Too Much Baggage and Cash Injections are both done, Lucia has Cisco and Nate on her side but still can’t win over Raina. Andrea has a plan: go to the planning room with Jason or Lucia to start the mission.

sections.h: Go to the Velvet Palm Motel
p: Drive to the Velvet Palm Motel in Tequesta. As Lucia, pick a vantage point: the containers Jason points out give a straight view into the motel windows.
Jason pretends to hire Raina as a dominatrix. Keep pressing the button whenever it appears to resist her, until Jason manages to open a window.
Back as Lucia, photograph Raina and Jason through the window. After a few shots Lucia leaves on her own.
As Jason, drive around the building to meet Lucia in the alley. The next day Lucia is at the gym: go upstairs and out to the pool, and talk to Nate on one of the loungers to complete the mission.

name: Adventures in Babysitting
desc: Jason works nightclub security for Andrés.

p: Some time after Making Gainz , Jason is called to work security for Andrés de León again. Drive to his house on Starfish Island and follow Paulo round to the back to meet Andrés, then drive to The Vault nightclub.

sections.h: Look After Andrés in the Club
p: Follow Andrés inside, stepping in when a drunk guy stops him at the entrance. On the first dance floor, order him a drink from the bartender on the left (he asked for it without lime, but getting it wrong doesn’t matter) and bring it to him by the stairs. Take a photo of him with his friends, then follow him upstairs.

Invite the group of girls on the right to Andrés’ booth, confirm the order with the bartender and take the free seat on the couch. Talk to Donatello’s security at the other booth when asked, then return to Andrés.
Take the drugs Andrés offers?
Up to you.
Up to you.

Take the drink Andrés hands you (you can’t refuse it) and follow him to the DJ booth, the office and back. Push your way out of the DJ booth and look for him at the table: his friends point you to the restroom on the far side of the floor, where he is in the last stall.

Andrés sends you outside to pick up his drugs. Take the main stairs down, exit through the door at the bottom and walk to the car that pulls up at the end of the alley on the right, then hurry back to Andrés at the bar in the southeast corner.

FAP gunmen storm the club. Jason’s vision is heavily distorted by the drugs until you get out. Fight your way through the floor with Andrés, grabbing weapons from fallen enemies, watch for a car full of gunmen at the bottom of the stairs and go through the door on the right. When an attacker tackles you, mash the prompt to stop him stabbing Jason.
Tip: Watch out for the civilians running away during the shootout if you want to keep a good Criminal Profile rating.
Outside, jump into the car with Andrés’ security and use the LMG through the roof to destroy the vehicles chasing you. Keep an eye on Jason’s health, because he takes a lot of damage up there.

Follow Paulo up the escalator and through the building, help Andrés across the train tracks and keep clearing enemies. Take the elevator up, follow Paulo onto the roof, clear the helipad and push Andrés into the helicopter.

Switch to the assault rifle, which has unlimited ammo here, and shoot at the enemy helicopters, changing side when prompted. Then switch to the rocket launcher: wait for the square on each chopper to turn red to lock on, and fire. Back at his house, Andrés learns that his son Rafa has been taken.
Tip: Aim at the tail rotors of the enemy helicopters: enough damage there brings them down faster than hitting the pilots or gunners.

name: Fresh Evidence
desc: Jason and Dre'Quan go after some blackmail material.

sections.h: Meet Dre’Quan at Jack of Hearts
p: Once both Watch It and Adventures in Babysitting are done, Dre’Quan calls Jason to deliver on his promise to the club owner. Go to his office at Jack of Hearts, focus on him and tell him you’re ready, then follow him out to the car waiting in the alley.

Drive to Starfish Island and wait for nightfall. Climb the wall where Dre’Quan stops, climb the boxes to the next floor and go into the workout room. Sneak up on the security guard on the far side and knock him out, then carry the body to the closet Dre’Quan opens. Follow the walkway to the door and open it with the Snap Gun.
Inside, follow the corridors to the bedroom while avoiding the tiger that wanders onto the balcony. Take the key card from the bedside table on the left of the bed.

The tiger now blocks the hallway, so follow Dre’Quan onto the balcony and drop down onto the cabanas. Two guards stand between you and the elevator: go along the wall to the right of the pool to the bar, grab a bottle and throw it to the left of the guards to distract them. In the living room, take the raw meat from the fridge on the right and throw it across the room to lure the tiger away, then follow Dre’Quan to the elevator.

In the basement, go into the round room with the big gold mural. Dre’Quan wants to decide who opens the door with rock, paper, scissors. If you lose, compare the symbols on the murals with the empty slot in the wall: you need the toy with the hand holding a microphone, the blue one in the middle on the far right. Pull it off the wall, put it in the slot and hold the prompt to open the door.
Squeeze into the surveillance room behind Dre’Quan. While he copies the files, interact with him to browse the videos together.

Take one or two guns from the wall and leave the room. Clear the guards coming into the basement, ride the elevator up and fight across the upper floor, watching the corners. Jump down from the far balcony as before and head for the dock.
Get into Dante’s speedboat and sail away until you lose the police to complete the mission.

name: Power Play
desc: Help out Kordell's crew and gather some intel.

p: After Child’s Play , Lucia is asked to help Kordell ’s crew with a robbery. Go to their base in Salton, talk to the receptionist and head down the hall on the left to the room where the crew is waiting.

The game switches to Jason, who has to get inside without being seen. Climb the ladder on the right side of the building, cross the roof and drop to the lower level on the far side, where an open door lets you in. Go down to the ground floor and open the door on the right with the Snap Gun to reach the planning room.

You can photograph a few things in the room, like the shirts on the rack, the bags near the garage door and the whiteboard. What matters is the whiteboard: look at it, flip it round and take a picture of the back, where the real heist plans are.
Back as Lucia, take the cones from the truck and drop them in a line across the road to stop the traffic, then follow Kordell and the others.
When Kordell kicks over the box by the side of the road, take an assault rifle from it. While the crew robs the armored truck, hold off the police arriving from every direction of the intersection.

Follow Kordell under the highway and into the construction site, then up through the floors of the building, watching the open sides for cops. Clear the rooftop and balcony ahead, go up one more floor and jump across to the highway. Keep moving between the crashed cars, watching for enemies in front and on the right.

sections.h: Steal a Car and Lose the Cops
p: When Kordell and Nate tell you to grab a car, don’t take one facing you, because that way is blocked: run to the end of the area and take the small car facing down the road. The crew shoots at anyone right behind you, so just focus on driving: take the first right on the highway to avoid the roadblock and you should lose the police quickly.

name: Child's Play
desc: Something comes up involving Rafa, and Jason and Lucia step in to help out an acquaintance.

p: After Fresh Evidence , Andrés calls Jason for help getting his son Rafa back from the kidnappers. Go to Megamundo HQ in Downtown as Jason or Lucia.

Tip: The map makes it look like this mission is on a timer, but it isn’t: you’ll simply be forced to play it once every other Jason and Lucia mission before Power Play is done. Doing it earlier makes no difference to the story.
After the cutscene you’re already in a car. Drive to the quarry south of VCIA and on to the meeting point, where Lucia gets out.
As Lucia, use the binoculars to look around and tag enemies. Rafa is in the upper-floor room of the building straight ahead, below the row of red lights along the walkway.

Lucia has a silenced pistol for taking out guards quietly. Keep to the right as you approach the buildings, climb the stairs and ladder in the middle of the metal structures, then take the stairs on the right up to Rafa’s level. Let the two guards coming down walk past, deal with the two at the corner of the walkway, enter the door on the left and take out the last guard to reach Rafa.

Back as Jason, the kidnappers pull their guns. Shoot the group in front of you and fall back towards the cars, watching for more enemies coming out of the building on the right. Switch to Lucia when prompted.

Lucia carries Rafa, so her aim is a bit worse. Head north along the walkway to the ladder, cover Rafa while he climbs down, then pick him up again and make for the ground. When Lucia is grabbed, mash the prompt to break free and shoot the man holding Rafa. Fight your way southeast while Rafa drives a forklift forward, then carry him to Gustavo at the door when the others pull up.

Gustavo drives off with Rafa, so give chase, switching to Lucia to shoot from the car. When your car flips, protect Andrés, then jump on a bike and keep chasing, using Lucia on the back to shoot the gunmen on the truck and on the bikes alongside you. When Jason spots a helicopter ahead, shoot the pilot or the gunmen inside.

sections.h: Save Rafa and Deal with Gustavo
p: Andrés runs Gustavo off the road. Run to the SUV on the train tracks, mash to cut Rafa’s seatbelt and pull him out. Then chase Gustavo up to the highway, where he fails to steal a car, and deal with him to complete the mission.

name: Headliners
desc: The Dimez perform at VYB, and Jason and Lucia help with the launch party.

info.Rewards: Up to around $50,000 (based on your choices) + 1 unlock

p: Find Dre’Quan near the club entrance and follow him while he shows Jason and Lucia around.
Lucia takes over the DJ booth. Play with the lights and effects as much as you like, then use the exit prompt to move on.
