Now as Jason, you decide who gets the three VIP tables. Each guest shows two numbers: the OFFER is what they pay right away to get in, while their FOLLOWERS can bring in extra money later in the night. Pick whoever you like, then hold the confirm prompt to lock in your choice.

Tip: A strong lineup is Donatello Lambrini (you deal with his assistant), who has by far the most followers, the Game Developer, who makes the biggest upfront offer, and KD, who has the second-biggest following and a history with Dre’Quan.

Switch to Lucia and do the rounds of the tables, starting with Maleek Rivers at the marked booth. He wants the lights changed to show off that he is in the club: go along with it, since his social media following is huge.
If you let KD in, Dre’Quan sends you over to his table. KD asks for a photo, so agree and snap a shot of him with the women at his table.

Back as Jason, head out to Dre’Quan. In the lobby a guy claims he has already been inside: throw him out or let him stay, it is up to you. When the cars pull up out front, open the door of the one to Dre’Quan’s right.
Follow Dre’Quan back inside as he brings his VIP guests in. Once he leaves, lead the group down the stairs to the dance floor and into the VIP area.
Dre’Quan wants Sexxy Red’s group to have a table, so you must kick out one of the three groups you let in earlier.

Tip: If the Game Developer is one of your guests, move them out. You keep their $50,000 upfront payment, they would not add many followers over the night anyway, and they take the “upgrade” better than anyone else.

Lucia is now in the green room. Follow Jason onto the balcony above the dance floor, then drop down to the lower level, go to the front right below DWNPLY and pull him off the stage. When his crew grabs Lucia, mash the prompt to break free and beat up the men who come at you.

Upstairs, Jason faces the toughest brawler in the game. He wears brass knuckles and hits very hard, so dodge his swings and be patient, as he takes a long time to go down. Later in the fight you can stab him with a knife from the bar counter, and Jason finishes it after taking one of his Brass Knuckles .
Back with Lucia in the green room, hit DWNPLY right after the cutscene to grab his gun and knock him out.

Jason and Lucia end up on the dance floor while the Dimez perform: dance together or just enjoy the set. When Dre’Quan comes over and asks if you want to stay or leave, pick either answer to see the final scene and complete the mission.

recompenses: Up to around $50,000 (based on your choices) Cash

name: Close Surveillance
desc: Jason uses a spy drone to keep an eye on some bodybuilders.

p: After Power Play , Karim has a plan to find the mole Kordell ’s crew has inside the airport. As Jason, go up to the top floor of the marked parking garage in Ocean Beach and meet him by his van. Francisco and Nate are on the move: Karim handles the microphone, so Jason takes the controls of the spy drone.
Tip: The drone flies much like a helicopter and keeps the same height on its own: use the triggers to go up and down.

sections.h: Find the Bodybuilders at The Calique
p: Fly the drone to The Calique, a rooftop bar nearby, and fly close to the white boxes to search the roof. Nate and Francisco are sitting under the small white shelter on the north side of the building.

Get close enough to fill the bar at the bottom of the screen, so Karim can hear what they’re saying, but don’t let them spot the drone. When they take the elevator down, fly over to the alley on its right to find Cisco’s car.
Follow the car while keeping the listening bar in the green, but stay high and don’t drop to street level. They make a stop where Nate picks up some gear, then carry on to an apartment building.
The man they’re meeting is Omar, the head baggage handler at the airport, in apartment 405. Fly up to the third balcony Karim points out and go in through the open door.

Move quickly to the marked spots and place the cameras. Start with the two in the living room, next to the TV and on the shelf on the opposite wall. Omar walks around the apartment, so watch the awareness indicator and stay in a different room. When he leaves the kitchen, place cameras on the corner of the counter, on top of the fridge and on the shelf by the front door. When he opens the bedroom door, slip in and put the last one on the shelf to the right of the bed.
Tip: If Omar heads your way, hide the drone and wait for him to leave the room before moving again.

Nate and Cisco arrive and rough Omar up. Switch between the cameras to follow them around the apartment as they force him to work for them: he’ll find out how much money goes through the airport vault and load it onto their plane on the day.
Karim accidentally broadcasts through the drone’s speaker, so fly out of the apartment before they find it. Out on the street, fly back to the van, marked with a green square.
Tip: Getting the drone back to the van earns you a Professional bonus for your Criminal Profile.

Back at the van, Lucia joins Jason and Karim, who has decrypted some footage from the hard drive: it shows a very powerful public figure. The plan now is to auction the drive to the highest bidder, with Valentina and Abe handling the deal, while Jason and Lucia keep working on the bodybuilders.
Get in the car with Lucia and drive her to the alley near Ajax Gym to complete the mission.

name: Delivery Method
desc: Jason goes undercover to help Andrea.

p: After Power Play , Andrea has a plan to help Lucia get through airport security on the day of the heist, when she’ll pose as the wine authenticator. Go to the planning room as Jason to meet her.
Andrea gets Jason into the airport disguised as a food delivery rider. Ride the bike south to the security gate and, once the guard lets you through, turn right and walk into the TSS office.
Talk to the receptionist. As soon as she leaves her desk, slip behind it and plug the flash drive into her computer. When the hack is done, interact again to pull the drive out.
To get upstairs you need everyone out of the building: pull the fire alarm behind the reception desk and wait for the staff to evacuate.

Head up the stairs to the second floor, where the Airport Security Department is. The computer with database access is in the office at the back left of the room: plug in the drive, wait for the hack to finish, then remove it.
Tip: Be quick: if you take too long, someone comes back into the building and you’ll be caught and reported for trespassing.
If you were fast enough, everyone is still at the muster point across the parking lot. Get back on the bike and ride out of the airport to complete the mission.
Tip: Getting in and out without being caught earns you a Professional bonus for your Criminal Profile.

name: Team Building
desc: Lucia meets Kordell and has to prove herself.

p: After Power Play , Kordell asks Lucia to meet him at Ajax Gym. Talk to him, then follow him outside and get into his car in the alley.
Drive to the warehouse Kordell tells you about. Once there, walk round the left side of the building and go in through the doorway.

As soon as Lucia walks in she’s dragged into an underground cage fight. Knock out the first opponent, then the second fighter who steps in. When a third man tries to join, Kordell jumps into the cage to help: finish off the remaining fighters together.
Tip: Block and dodge with the prompt shown on screen, then hit back with melee attacks: timing your dodges makes these fights much easier.
Back outside, once Arlo has left, get into Kordell’s car again and drive to the Riverbank Waterside Bar.
Follow Kordell into the bar. He takes Lucia to meet Raul , whom Cisco has been tailing, and the mission ends after a tense standoff.

name: Fully Catered
desc: Jason and Lucia steal a catering truck.

sections.h: Steal a Plane & Simple Catering Truck
p: The area is off-limits, and any worker who spots you will report you for trespassing, so take it slow if you want to stay unseen. Circle around the right side of the building where the trucks are parked, keeping out of sight, and climb the lower section to reach the roof. Walk across the roof to the parked catering trucks and drop down on the left side of the middle one, where there are usually no workers around. Break into the truck: the Slim Jim makes it quick.
Drive the truck out of the airport and take it to the marked drop-off in Rockridge.

Back in the planning room, Raul talks to Jason while the two of them fill bags with fake cash, which will be swapped for the bodybuilders’ real money during VCIA Takedown . Grab bundles from the pile and put them in the bags a few times to finish the mission.

name: VCIA Takedown
desc: The airport heist is a go.

info.Featuring: Andrea Francisco Delgado Kordell Grant Nate

p: The heist opens with Lucia inside the airport. Stay close to Nate as he walks through the terminal.
Control switches to Jason, who is at the wheel of the stolen catering truck with the crew on board. Drive it around the airport grounds to the cargo terminal.

Back with Lucia, keep following Nate while he escorts the wine sommelier. Once Nate spills a drink on Janice, tail her into the restroom, sneak up behind her and knock her out. Lucia hides her in one of the stalls automatically.
After a quick meeting with Raul in disguise, stay behind Nate as he pushes the wine crate after the vault manager. In the elevator the manager asks you about the wine, and you can answer him.

Now you control Jason on the airport roof, with a 5-minute timer. Head for the marker in the middle of the rooftop. Guards patrol the area, including some on the raised platforms, so take them out quietly with your silenced pistol or sneak up and knock them out. The terminal is inside the caged area on the upper level: interact with it to continue.

As Lucia, follow the vault manager inside and inspect the wine crate. When Kordell gives the signal, knock the manager out, then run back down the hallway and press both buttons to open the vault gates. Once Lucia has tied up the guards, return to the vault, grab the bags and follow Francisco back to the elevator.
Switch to Jason, knock Omar out, then pick him up and drop him into the marked container before anyone sees him.
Lucia drives the baggage cart with Kordell’s crew to the plane at the south terminal. Take the bags off the cart one by one and put them on the loader ramp.

Things go wrong and the police swarm the tarmac. As Jason, fight your way to the plane, watching for cops popping out from behind containers and vehicles. When he gets close, the game switches to Lucia, who has to hold off the police around her.
Jason jumps into a truck and races after the plane. Pull up on its right side, close to the landing gear, so Lucia can jump on and climb inside.
Next, chase the getaway truck with Jason while police cars join the pursuit. Stay on it until it reaches the highway.
Inside the plane, Lucia has to beat Raina in a fistfight. She goes down much more easily than the big guy Jason fought in Headliners , so just keep landing punches.

Back with Jason, keep chasing the truck. When a man in the back starts throwing things at you, use Focus to shoot him quickly. After the truck crashes, run over and check it: Omar crawls out of the wreck.
Tip: Shoot Omar in the leg or knock him out instead of killing him to get the Professional bonus.

As Lucia, work your way to the front of the plane. Every gunman on board is one of the gang members Raul hired, so you can fight through them freely, but watch for the ones hiding between the seats. When Kordell grabs you, follow the button prompts to fight back, then shoot him as he is dragged toward the open door to throw him off the plane.
One last time as Jason, hold off the NOOSE agents while Andrea loads the bags into the van. You can pick up Francisco’s LMG-6 from the ground to help out, and you get to keep it.
When Andrea calls out that the bags are loaded, jump into the van.

The last part puts you in the cockpit with Lucia and Raul. Hold the controls and pull back to keep the plane steady until it comes down in Vice City Bay. After the closing scenes, Raul tells everyone to lie low while he, Valentina and Abe sell the hard drive. The story continues later with Sunset .

name: Tie Up Loose Ends
desc: After the heist, Jason and Lucia wait to hear from Raul about the hard drive.

p: Tie Up Loose Ends isn’t a regular mission with a marker to follow: it’s the waiting period right after VCIA Takedown . Raul has the hard drive and is supposed to get in touch about selling it, so the game simply asks you to wait for his message. There is no map marker for it, but it appears in the story list on your map as a mandatory main mission with a pink icon.

Raul’s call never comes, no matter how long you wait. What actually moves the story on is Valentina : she calls with an update on the hard drive sale and says you can call her back if you want to speed things up. Call her back from Jason’s or Lucia’s phone, or select the objective on the map to dial her automatically. Once some more time passes, a note is left for you at the Y Hotel front desk, and picking it up starts Sunset , which completes Tie Up Loose Ends.
Tip: Calling Valentina back is not strictly required, but it makes Sunset show up much sooner. If you skip the call, the story only moves on after a longer wait while you do other activities.

You’re free to do whatever you like in the meantime. Yasmani ’s optional bank job, That’s Where the Money Is… , becomes available at this point and is a good way to earn extra cash, but you don’t need it to progress.
Tip: Tie Up Loose Ends is not missable: it’s a mandatory step of the story and always ends once Sunset begins.

name: That's Where the Money Is…
desc: Yasmani has a tip about a security van that could lead you straight to a bank vault.

info.Rewards: Around $80,000 in marked bills (if you grab them all) + 1 unlock

p: After VCIA Takedown , Yasmani gets in touch with a tip: it’s your first chance to rob a bank vault on your own. Go to Café Orquídea in Ocean Beach , head inside and take a seat by the window to wait for the security van.
As soon as the van drives past, run back to your car and follow it. Keep some distance, or the driver will notice you.

sections.h: Follow the Guard into the Bank
p: The van stops outside a bank. Park nearby and follow the guard inside on foot.
Inside, put on a disguise and pull out your gun to start the robbery. Plant explosives on the doorway at the back of the room to blow it open, then take out the guards waiting in the vault.

The marked bills are piled on a cart in the corner of the vault. There’s usually more than two bags can hold, so hand a full bag to your partner to free up space, or switch to them and keep grabbing the cash yourself.
Tip: Take every marked bill you can: a full haul is worth around $80,000.

The robbery gives you an instant four-star wanted level, and the police start shooting straight away. The bank has no back exit, so fight your way out through the front. Let your partner drive while you shoot at the cars chasing you.

Tip: The highway helps if your car is fast, but expect frequent roadblocks. Once you break line of sight, pull into a parking lot away from the main road, swap cars, take off your disguise and put on a hat and glasses from your inventory.
When you’re clear, bring the stolen money to Yasmani to sell it. From now on he also sells Security Van tips, so you can keep robbing bank vaults whenever you like.

recompenses: Around $80,000 in marked bills (if you grab them all) Cash
Yasmani starts selling Security Van tips Unlocked

name: Sunset
desc: Jason and Lucia go looking for answers.

p: The mission opens at the Y Hotel with Valentina calling Lucia: she now knows about the hard drive and is working on a deal with the potential buyers, Camila Fuentes and Giorgio Gallo . She advises against pushing people this powerful and would rather get a good deal than a quick one, but tells Lucia to call her back if they want to speed things up.
Call Valentina back as Lucia and tell her you want to move the deal along. She agrees to put some pressure on the buyers.

Santino from guest services then calls: a note is waiting for you at the front desk. Go down to the Y Hotel lobby and collect it. It says that Raul ’s boat is at Ocean Beach Marina. You can get changed before heading out if you like.
On the way, Jason calls Abe to ask about Raul, but Abe claims he doesn’t know him and says Valentina is his only contact. Drive down to the marina on the bay as the sun sets.

Walk along the dock to Raul’s houseboat. The place has clearly been turned over: go inside and search the boat until Jason finds Raul, beaten and barely alive. He is in the small bathroom behind the second door on the left.

Raul tells Jason and Lucia that the cops did this to him and that it was Valentina who gave him up, but that Andrea still has the drive. He knows he won’t make it and begs Jason to finish it before the police arrive.

The boat is surrounded by a joint task force of police and NOOSE. Fight your way along the marina docks with Lucia, moving from cover to cover as more units keep pushing in. You can switch between Jason and Lucia at any time so they cover each other. A police helicopter joins the fight: take it down early and the rest of the docks get much easier. Keep pushing until you reach the far end of the dock.
Tip: You start the shootout with a high wanted level and enemies flanking from several directions, so never stay out in the open for long.

Reach a boat and get away by sea, taking turns at the wheel and shooting at the pursuing police boats. When you are running low, grab more weapons from the gun locker on board. Ammo is limited here: once your assault rifle runs dry, the game swaps you to the other character while your partner takes the wheel. More cops show up on boats and helicopters once you leave the marina.

Lucia has a plan: set the autopilot, squeeze between the barges ahead and jump off, so the cops keep chasing the empty boat. Time it right, then stay hidden to complete the mission. The story carries straight on into Starting From Zero .

name: Starting From Zero
desc: The final mission of Chapter 4.

p: Leave the junkyard, take the car parked nearby and drive to the Aqua Stadium to meet Andrea . Police are searching every part of the city, so drive carefully and stay out of their sight. If the cops spot you at any point, Andrea decides to leave and drops the hard drive for you to collect instead.
Tip: If you have cash on you, a quick stop at a nearby clothing store for new outfits makes Jason and Lucia harder to recognize. It helps, but it is not required.
Once you get there, head up into the stands. Andrea is sitting toward the southwest end of the stadium.

sections.h: Go to Big House Storage Inc
p: After the talk with Andrea, you need the statue from the storage unit. Police arrive at the front of the stadium, so ditch your car: head south toward the boat storage area and steal the car parked outside the building. Drive carefully to the storage unit in Crosstown and walk inside, and the pair grabs what they came for automatically.

A text from Mattia sends you to a hotel. As Lucia, go inside and take the elevator, then follow the hostess when she stops you upstairs. When the game switches to Jason, go in and ride the elevator up to the terrace too.

The scenes continue at Giorgio Gallo ’s penthouse, where you are given the chance to shoot Mattia. Do whatever you like: the gun is not loaded, it is only Giorgio testing you, so Mattia is unharmed whether you pull the trigger or let the timer run out.
Follow Giorgio as he shows you around the penthouse where you will be staying, then follow Dardan to the bedroom. Jason and Lucia go to bed, the mission ends and Bird in the Hand starts right away.

name: Bird in the Hand
desc: Jason and Lucia boost a new ride.

p: Giorgio wakes you up. Change clothes at the wardrobe and take a good look around the penthouse, because it is your home base for the rest of the story. Go downstairs and through the door by the elevators to find Giorgio in the gym.

sections.h: Scope Out the Coast Guard Base
p: Once everyone is in the helicopter, fly to the coast guard base. The game switches to Lucia, who has to study the base from above. Look at:
The helicopter then moves to the other side of the base. Look at the drawbridge on the right, then at the boat in the corner of the dock with more packages on pallets.

sections.h: Fly to the Bridge and Meet Kevin
p: Back at the controls as Jason, fly to the bridge on the western edge of Vice City, then head south toward the marker near Key Lento. You don’t have to fly the whole way: once the conversation ends, the game skips ahead.
The crew jumps out over the air base. Skydive down, open your parachute and land on the boat, then drive it to the marked spot south of the military base.

Night falls and the team moves in, led by Vinny . You can switch the night vision goggles on and off to see better. When you reach the grate, interact with it and cut through the bars, then follow Vinny through the sewer until Jason comes out inside the base.

Make your way above ground to the hangar. Soldiers are everywhere, but they won’t see you as long as you stay in the shadows, so you can skip most fights. Tag enemies to keep track of them, or whistle to lure one over and knock him out. The middle of the roads is fairly quiet, so you can cut almost straight across. When Vinny points out the truck on the left, knock out the soldier crouching at the back and climb in: it carries you closer to the hangar. When you get out, wait for passing trucks and run across to the building.
Climb the ladders on the side of the hangar to reach the roof and go in through the hatch.
Tip: Reach the hatch without being detected to get the Professional bonus.
With everyone inside, you switch to Lucia. Go to the end of the walkway and use the console to open the hangar doors.

Soldiers pour in as soon as the doors open. Keep them away while the helicopter is backed out, and take them down quickly as they come through the doors so they don’t damage it. When prompted, jump into the helicopter.

On the way back, enemy helicopters close in from the sides: shoot the soldiers riding in them. Then switch to Jason when prompted and use the rocket launcher on the jets chasing you. Keep each jet in your sights until the square turns red, then fire so the rockets lock on. Destroy both jets to complete the mission.
The story continues with Taking Liberties .

name: Taking Liberties
desc: A new plan comes together.

p: Head to the marked room next to the gym, where Giorgio is relaxing in the spa. He explains what he can offer Jason and Lucia in return for their help, but the conversation is cut short by an unexpected visitor sent by the Albanian mob.
When Giorgio gets out of the spa, follow him to his office. The man waiting for you at the desk is an unexpected cameo from the series! The mission ends after the cutscene there.
The man sitting at the desk when you walk into the office is a familiar face for longtime fans of the series: it’s none other than Niko Bellic , the protagonist of GTA IV!
Once it’s done you are free to move around the penthouse, and two new missions become available: Doggie Bag with Vinny and VC Baby with Mattia .

name: Doggie Bag
desc: Meet Vinny and go hunting for some contraband.

p: You play as Lucia outside a docked cruise ship and have to sneak aboard. Go through the open garage ahead of you, then take the hallway on the left to stay away from the worker on the right side of the shelves. Use the Snap Gun to quietly open the blue Storage door. In the next room you can grab some cash, then knock out the worker so you can get to the other side. Wait outside until all the guards move away from the gangway, then walk across into the ship.
Tip: Lucia’s silenced pistol is loaded with non-lethal rounds, so a headshot knocks guards out without killing them.

sections.h: Take the Elevator to the Top Deck
p: Make your way up to the higher deck, dealing with any guards along the way. In the next big area, take the elevator up to the top deck.

Go outside and follow the deck to the southeast, knocking out the guards in your path. The lower walkways are a bit further from the patrols, so taking the stairs down makes things easier. Rocco is near the pool area at the back, with some guards around him.
Wait for Rocco to come close, focus on him and feed him the drugged biscuit. Once he falls asleep, pick him up.

Carry Rocco to the landing zone at the far southeast end of the ship. Stick to the edge of the deck all the way to the back, knocking out any guards who get in your way, then jump into the helicopter to escape and complete the mission.

name: VC Baby
desc: Mattia gets in touch and asks for help.

p: Follow Kat and Mattia to the elevator, where Mattia asks Jason and Lucia for help.
Will you help Mattia get to the hospital?
You play the rest of the mission and drive Mattia to the hospital yourself.
Affects: Final scene of the mission
The mission ends on the spot. Mattia finds his own way out: he jumps off the balcony and breaks his leg on purpose, so Giorgio has Dardan drive him to the hospital.
Affects: Final scene of the mission
If you agree to help, Lucia heads to the living room to distract Dardan. When she throws his phone into the pool, rush over and grab the key fob from the couch where he was sitting.
Go back to Mattia by the car elevator and ride it down to the garage, where all of Giorgio’s cars are parked. Pick whichever one you like.
Drive Mattia across the city to the hospital in the northeast. You have just under 4 minutes, which is plenty as long as you drive carefully and don’t wreck the car.
Tip: Reach the hospital in time for the birth to earn the mission’s top bonus.
Follow Mattia into the hospital. After that you are taken back to the penthouse automatically and the mission is complete.

name: Operation Savage Glory
desc: A valuable shipment needs to be recovered.

p: Go upstairs in the penthouse, where Vinny is waiting for you to go over the plan.

The operation opens with Lucia. Drive the boat to the bridge, pull up alongside the pier and climb onto it. Interact with the side of the pillar and slide the gadget across the wall until the light on the back turns bright green, then place the charge. Do the same on the other side of the pillar.

Switch to Jason in the helicopter heading for the cargo ship carrying the rival cocaine shipment. You get a sniper rifle with unlimited ammo and have to clear the deck before you can land. Look for the lights on the enemies’ guns to spot them, and as you get closer Kevin points the helicopter’s searchlight at targets for you.

Once on deck, follow Rocco and keep him safe by dealing with every enemy that shows up; Kevin also calls out positions when he spots them first. Rocco stops at a container on the upper level: open it with the Cut-off Tool, go inside and open the crate at the back to plant explosives.

sections.h: Plant the Rest of the Explosives
p: Keep following Rocco. An enemy helicopter pulls up on the left side of the ship, so take it out as soon as it appears. Rocco leads you to two more containers midway along the ship, where you plant charges on the sides, and then to a final one: open it and throw the last batch of explosives inside.

Hold out until the helicopter comes back, fighting off the enemies on deck and in the windows of the ship ahead with Rocco’s help. When it arrives on the left, jump in and detonate the explosives to blow up the ship.

Lucia takes over for the rest of the operation. Enter the bridge control building on the right, knock out the operator upstairs and use the controls to raise the bridge. Then plant a charge on the controls and blow them up.

Put on the scuba mask, dive off the side of the bridge and follow Vinny underwater. When you reach the boat, take the explosives from Vinny and place them on its hull. Keep following him to the grate, then use the drill to unscrew all the bolts and enter the tunnel.

sections.h: Sneak into the Coast Guard Offices
p: Back on dry land, circle around the building to the right toward the offices, staying on the right side away from the buildings and following the road to the far end. Guards stand in pairs there: shoot one and Vinny takes down the other at the same moment. Slip inside through the doors, deal with the guards on your way to the large garage, including the two inside it, then open the shutter door.

sections.h: Cover the Team from the Air
p: As Jason, fly the helicopter inland toward the base, then switch to sniping from the side door again, with Kevin lighting up targets for you.

Back on the ground with Lucia, stay with the truck as it drags the cargo outside and fight off the enemies around it. When prompted, switch to Jason and shoot the soldier on the roof who is about to fire an RPG at the helicopter. You can also shoot down the helicopters dropping in reinforcements, plus any soldiers on the walkways and rooftops.
Switch back to Lucia when prompted, keep the enemies off you, then run to the cargo and hook the winch onto it.

Lucia rides out on the cargo net while the helicopter takes off. Move left and right around the cargo for cover and better angles, and detonate the explosives on the boats when prompted. Jason then throws down a grenade launcher with unlimited ammo: use it freely on the vehicles chasing you and on the helicopters that follow you through the city, which hold a fairly steady position and make easy targets.

Tip: When Kevin warns you that the net is about to hit a tower, move to the right side of the net. Do the same when he warns you about the train, or the cargo slams into it with you on the wrong side.

The operation is a success, but not the whole crew makes it back. You end up at the penthouse with everything you had before Chapter 5 returned to you. Take one of the elevators out of the penthouse to complete the mission, and Honest Abe starts right away.
Vinny and Liz are both killed during Operation Savage Glory.

recompenses: All weapons, gear and outfits from before Chapter 5 returned Unlocked

name: Honest Abe
desc: Time to negotiate a deal with Abe.

p: Head to Abe ’s office in Downtown Vice City. The mission is a single cutscene: once it’s over and you walk out of his office, the open world is fully available again.
The story continues with Unfinished Business .

name: Unfinished Business
desc: The hard drive deal is almost done: tie up loose ends or move ahead with Abe’s offer.

sections.h: Tie Up Loose Ends or Take Abe’s Offer
p: Unfinished Business is a short story step rather than a full mission, and it starts right after Honest Abe . The hard drive deal is being wrapped up in the background, so the game gives you a choice of pace: use the free time to finish any side activities you still have open, or move the story forward by going ahead with Abe ’s offer.

When you are ready, follow the Meet with Abe objective to Abe’s office. This second meeting is where you finalize the legal deal. His fee is $150,000, sent to Abe’s office through BuckMe, so make sure you have the money before you go.

⚠️ Point of no return: once you sign Abe’s deal there is no going back, and the story heads into the finale. Finish any side content you care about, and make a manual save in a spare slot, before you go to his office.
As soon as you leave Abe’s office, the game automatically sends you back to Giorgio ’s penthouse.
When you get back to the penthouse, a new cutscene with Giorgio plays. It completes Unfinished Business and leads straight into the next mission, Protective Custody .

name: Protective Custody
desc: The couple work together.

p: Protective Custody kicks off the finale. Right before you walk into Abe’s office in Unfinished Business , the game asks if you are ready to wrap up the story: choose Postpone if you still want to free roam. Once you go ahead, this mission and The End of the Road play back to back all the way to the credits. After the credits, the game puts you back at the point just before this mission, so you can keep playing in free roam.

Tip: Make a manual save in a spare slot before starting the finale: missions can’t be replayed and the single autosave is overwritten after every mission. For the best ending you also need Jason and Lucia’s relationship at Hot Together, $2,000,000 in Family Savings and clean Criminal Profiles.

Back at the penthouse, Jason heads out for a drop-off while you stay with Lucia. Giorgio challenges her to sink the shot Dardan left on the pool table: bank the cue ball off the cushions three times to pot the 8-ball.
The game switches to Jason. Walk to the far southeast corner of Panos Plaza and sit on the marked bench. Once the drop has been collected, walk back to Dardan.
What follows is one of the biggest twists of the story.

Giorgio betrays Jason and Lucia. The two are taken into custody separately, and statewide prosecutor Danica Howard tells Lucia they will never be free unless they get the hard drive back from Giorgio. Meanwhile, dirty cops try to get rid of both of them.

Jason is walked to a cell at the police station by Deputy Fitzroy, then the game switches to Lucia, locked inside a police transport. Follow the prompts to break free and unlock her cuffs, then shoot the gang members as soon as they open the door. Grab one of the weapons they drop, fight off the rest of the gang closing in, and run until you lose them.
After a short scene Lucia jumps on a bike. Head south along the highway toward Jason.

Back with Jason, Fitzroy lets him out of his cell. Follow her down the hallway to the left, then close the door in the room on the left and push a locker in front of it. Head upstairs: Jason shoves a gang member off the stairs and takes his gun. Make your way to the east side of the building, watching for enemies in the side rooms and coming up the stairs. You start with a single magazine, so run over fallen enemies to pick up more ammo. In the last room, run to the railing to continue.

Turn back and follow Fitzroy a short way down the hallway into the armory on the right. She uncuffs Jason, and you can grab long guns there to shoot at the enemies in the street and in the buildings opposite. Go back to the locker where Jason took the guns in the cutscene for body armor and extra weapons.

Fight your way down the alley to the open warehouse door, watching for more enemies at ground level. Fitzroy is hit as she opens the door, so deal quickly with the enemies who rush inside. Then move up to the door and hold off the NOOSE assault: more units keep arriving in vehicles until the section ends.

Lucia picks up on the edge of Hamlet and has to reach the warehouse where Jason is pinned down. Patrol cars drive around looking for her, and enemies can pop out from behind houses as you cross the yards. Getting spotted isn’t a failure, but it gives away your position; you can also simply rush across the yards and leave the pursuers behind.

Outside the warehouse, take out all the marked enemies. Méndez then pops up through the roof of a vehicle on a mounted gun. Stay in cover while he is firing, and shoot him in the head over the top of the gun when you get a window. After enough damage he drops back into the truck and more enemies arrive: clear them and he comes back up. Check the trunks of the vehicles around the area for weapons, body armor and healing items. Deal enough damage to trigger the final scene.

The mission ends with STF officer Méndez slumped against a truck tyre and both Jason and Lucia’s guns pointed at him. At first the only prompt is Shoot; if you let him keep talking for about a minute, a second prompt, Take Deal, appears next to it.
Shoot Méndez or take his deal?
Press Shoot as soon as it appears.
Wait about a minute for the prompt, then take it.
How to get it: at the end of Protective Custody, don’t shoot Méndez. Let him talk for about a minute until Take Deal appears next to Shoot, then take it.

What happens: Méndez offers Jason and Lucia a partnership: get him the files and the three of them will run the city with no cops or feds in the way. He calls off his men and sends them up to Giorgio Gallo’s office on the 40th floor of a high-rise to pull the files from his computer. They get the hard drive out, but as more police arrive Méndez has them cuffed, just “for the optics”, and drives them away. The credits roll over an alligator in a misty swamp, lying next to two skulls. You never reach the bridge or see Cal’s post-credits scene.

name: The End of the Road
desc: The final mission of the GTA 6 story.

p: The final mission starts at the hangar at Brian ’s Marina in the Keys, while Cal ’s laptop works on decrypting the hard drive. Stock up before you leave: every weapon laid out for the assault is yours to take, so grab your favorites along with body armor and explosives, then walk out of the area marked in pink on the minimap to set off.
Tip: It’s a long mission, about 25 minutes before the final choice, so bring body armor and grenades.
Head to a waterfront high-rise with a helicopter giving you cover, then fight your way back out through a construction site. The target is Giorgio ’s penthouse, where the hard drive is.
You fly to the tower automatically and take control of Lucia on the helicopter’s mounted gun. Gun down the enemies who appear along the balconies.

After a loop around the building, Jason drops in. Fight your way to the office at the back of the floor, with more enemies pouring in as you go. Walk behind the desk and Jason plugs Cal’s equipment into the computer automatically.
Back with Lucia in the helicopter, shoot at the enemy chopper to keep it busy, then turn your fire on the enemies closing in on Jason inside the penthouse.

As Jason, head back to the office for the drive. Cross to the opposite side of this floor and climb the collapsed section up to the floor above. Your earlier route is blocked there, so go around past the elevators to reach the office, then pick the hard drive up off the floor.
The game switches to Lucia, stranded on a crane. Run to the far end and jump just as it starts to fall to make it inside the penthouse.
Jason climbs down the elevator shaft to the garage, where enemies are already shooting at Lucia. Clear them all out, then go to Lucia and pull her out from under the rubble.

Now you control both of them and can switch between Jason and Lucia at any time. Keep fighting your way to the opposite side of the garage floor, picking up the body armor there if yours is broken, then climb up next to the blue car.

Get in the car and hold the accelerator as you race around the outside of the building to dodge the helicopter’s fire. When the car jumps, shoot the two gunmen in the helicopter to bring it down. Then walk into the elevator at the construction site.
The cops get tipped off, so leaving on Cal’s boat is no longer an option: instead you have to reach a plane waiting at South Point airfield.
After the scenes, you are already in a car: follow the objective to Cal’s house first, then keep driving south along the road toward Fleming Key.

On the way, sheriff’s cars and a helicopter block the road on a bridge. Jason and Lucia talk it over in the car, the colour drains from the screen and you get the final choice. Listen to Jason’s first line: if he tells Lucia “Don’t draw your weapon”, your save qualifies for one of the good endings.
Swim for It or No Surrender?
The outcome was already decided by your save before you press anything.
Your save makes no difference here.
The endings are numbered from worst to best.

The first (bad) ending of GTA VI doesn't even let you play this final mission. If you take Mendez 's Deal, the game ends early as part of the Protective Custody mission. The other four endings all come from the bridge in this mission.

How to get it: choose Swim for It on a save that doesn’t qualify for the good endings, for example with a Psycho or Irredeemable Criminal Profile. You can tell straight away, because Jason starts explaining the plan to get in the water instead of telling Lucia to keep her gun down.

What happens: the plan is to ride the current out to a sandbar, steal a boat and head for Cuba. When the deputies order them out, Jason steps out of the car with one hand in the air but his pistol still in the other. The deputies open fire: Jason goes down on the road and Lucia is shot before she even gets out of the car. Their son Tomás ends up with Lucia’s family.
How to get it: choose No Surrender at the roadblock. Your relationship, savings and profile make no difference.

What happens: on the drive to the airfield it comes out that Lucia had been offered a deal to walk away on her own, and turned it down to stay with Jason. At the roadblock they kiss one last time and Jason floors it straight at the sheriff’s cars, while you control Lucia and shoot back. It always ends the same way: they smash through the barricade and are gunned down in their seats, still holding hands. Tomás is raised by Lucia’s family and only knows his parents from a framed photo.

How to get it: choose Swim for It with Jason and Lucia’s relationship at Hot Together, a clean Criminal Profile and less than $2,000,000 in Family Savings. Jason opens with “Don’t draw your weapon”, and the only prompt after that is Exit.

What happens: they both step out unarmed with their hands up and climb onto the bridge wall, where Jason quietly slips Lucia a phone and says they’ll jump on three. At the last second he lets go of her hand and stays behind: Lucia drops into the water and escapes, while the deputies pin Jason to the tarmac. The credits open on his mugshot, and the final scene shows Lucia bringing their son to the prison visiting window, his hand pressed against the glass.
How to get it: choose Swim for It with the relationship at Hot Together, the full $2,000,000 in Family Savings and clean profiles for both Jason and Lucia.

What happens: the bridge plays out exactly like Ending 4, but then the screen jumps “Two years later” to a roadside diner. Lucia arranges a meeting with Abe , who later texts her “It’s done”, and her banking app shows $2,500,000 going out. Jason walks out of prison, meets his son, and the three of them drive off together. It’s the only ending where Jason and Lucia both survive and stay together.

Tip: you don’t need to replay the whole game to see every ending. After the credits, you return to just before the finale: take Take Deal for Ending 1, No Surrender for Ending 3, or top up Family Savings to $2,000,000 in free roam and replay the finale to turn Ending 4 into Ending 5.

In all four bridge endings, stay until the end of the credits for a short scene with Cal waiting for the hard drive files to decrypt. Afterwards the game takes you back to just before the finale with both Jason and Lucia playable, so you can replay it for a different ending.
The End of the Road can end in several different ways. See our GTA 6 endings guide for all five endings and how to get each one.
